title: Strategic Executive Assistant to the CEO
description:
The Vision


At AI Leadership, we believe in clarity, structure, and well-run operations that allow our team to focus on the work that creates the greatest impact. The Strategic EA role exists to provide end-to-end leverage to the CEO by owning tactical and operational execution: inbox, calendar, logistics, and meeting prep. We are looking for a \"thinking partner\" who can maintain the highest standards of operational excellence and brand representation.


Who We’re Looking For


The Strategic Executive Assistant (EA) will act as the CEO's \"20% focus\" unlock, allowing him to drive 80% of business outcomes. This is not a role for someone who only follows rigid rules; we need an individual who can operate with nuance, anticipate needs before they are stated, and understand the CEO's unique decision-making framework.

You will be measured on your ability to triage the CEO's inbox to 95% without escalation and reduce calendar friction to near-zero. If you are a high-nuance individual who \"just gets it\" and thrives in a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.



Why You Should Join Us


  • AI Frontier : Gain direct exposure to the AI space and learn to build and refine AI-driven automation.
  • Career Growth : We are a growing organization that values internal mobility; this role has a path toward operations or management, as demonstrated by previous incumbents.
  • High-Impact Environment : Work alongside experienced leaders who prioritize growth, ambition, and proactive problem-solving.


Role Responsibilities


The 20% That Drives 80% of Success

  • Inbox Ownership : Manage the CEO's inbox end-to-end, responding to all messages within 24 hours using his tone and zero \"emotional leakage\".
  • Strategic Calendar Defense : Own the calendar to ensure it reflects strategic priorities; proactively identify gaps or blockers and coordinate with the family assistant to honor personal time.
  • Flawless Travel & Logistics : Execute end-to-end travel (flights, hotels, ground transport) and remain on-call for any transit issues.
  • Meeting Readiness : Maintain prep docs and ensure the CEO is fully prepared for every internal and external stakeholder interaction.

The Remaining 80%

  • HubSpot & CRM Maintenance : Review deals weekly, ensure follow-up tasks are executed on time, and load new contacts sourced by the CEO.
  • SOP & Notion Management : Fully own and update all CEO-related workflows and databases, ensuring documentation is audit-ready and searchable.
  • Small-Scope Project Management : Lead projects assigned by the Exec Ops Manager, assessing needs, developing plans, and communicating status to stakeholders.


Skills & Attributes We're Looking For


  • Methodical & Nuanced : You understand the difference between tactical execution and strategic decision-making and can operate independently in ambiguous situations.
  • 1–3 Years of Relevant Experience : Ideally supporting senior leaders or working in high-growth, corporate, or communications-heavy environments.
  • Proactive Tech-Savviness : Proficiency with Google Workspace, Slack, HubSpot (or similar CRMs), and Notion, plus a strong drive to use AI tools for speed and efficiency.
  • Executive Presence : You have a professional audio/video setup and communicate with the polish required for CEO-facing interactions.
  • Coachability : You believe feedback is the \"breakfast of champions\" and iterate quickly based on guidance.


Our Values


  • Create remarkable experiences – Every interaction is a chance to satisfy customers and internal team members.
  • Always be growing – Committed to continuous improvement and individual learning.
  • Deliver results – Taking initiative to solve problems and drive success regardless of formal responsibility.
  • Do the right thing – Prioritizing integrity, respect, and discretion in all interactions.
  • Practice what we teach – Pushing the boundaries of what it means to be AI-driven.

Compensation & Location


  • Compensation : Starts at $2,200 USD
  • Location : Remote (Working within 8 AM - 5 PM CST is preferred).


Application & Selection Process


TO APPLY:

  • Send your Resume (PDF titled \"Lastname.Firstname.EA.pdf\") to (Operations+ ).
  • Record a short demo video (2 - 4 mins max) highlighting your relevant experience for the role, skills, successes, and goals for the future. Also, we’d like you to briefly mention the following insights: Process Optimization Proposal: Share an example of how you’ve improved an operational workflow in the past (Preferably using AI or automation tools). We want you to showcase your personality, and why you believe you are the ideal candidate for the Strategic Executive Assistant role.


Our process is thorough but rewarding. Here is what you can expect:

  • Technical AI Prompt Test and Strategic Thinking Exercise
  • Behavioral Assessments : Working Genius (to assess natural strengths) and Kolbe A Index.

Three-Step Interview sequence : Initial Screening call → Head of Operations → CEO.

title: Senior Product Experience Designer (Remote) - B2B Healthtech SaaS
description:
• Ongoing contract role · 10 hours per week · Remote (Brazil Based)
  • Flexible hours · PST time zone overlap preferred
  • International team across Brazil and North America
  • 5+ years of designing SaaS web applications (required)
  • Hands-on product experience design - workflows, flows, wireframes
  • Fluent English required - written and spoken


About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Experience Designer to help shape the user experience of a SaaS web application platform that supports healthcare practitioners in delivering better patient outcomes.


This role is intentionally scoped at 10 hours per week , with some overlap during PST business hours required. It’s focused on senior-level product experience design - the kind of work where judgment, clarity, and good decisions matter.


This role is well suited to someone who:

  • enjoys focused, high-impact work,
  • may already have other professional commitments,
  • and values collaborating with a small, international team on meaningful product problems.


You’ll work closely with the founder and an experienced product, design, and development team to design end-to-end product experiences — from early concepts through to wireframes ready for visual design and implementation.


This is not a UI-polish role, and it’s not advisory. You will be designing the product experience itself.


About Optive

We build software that helps functional medicine and healthcare practitioners deliver better patient outcomes through clearer data, better insight, and more consistent follow-up care. Optive is the next stage of this work - a patient engagement and care platform designed to support ongoing, relationship-based healthcare rather than one-off interactions.


Our team works across two closely related platforms:

  • Optive - a patient engagement and care platform
  • Optimal DX - an established diagnostics and lab interpretation system used by practitioners today


You’ll contribute experience design work across both platforms , helping ensure coherence and clarity as the ecosystem evolves.


Our team is fully remote and international, working across Brazil and North America, with collaboration primarily across PST time zones - often a good fit for Brazil-based team members who prefer some evening overlap.



What You'll Do

  • Design end-to-end user journeys for complex SaaS web applications
  • Translate product goals into clear workflows, flows, and wireframes
  • Think through user intent, edge cases, and complexity vs. simplicity trade-offs
  • Create low-fidelity wireframes and experience diagrams (Figma, Miro, etc.)
  • Collaborate with a senior visual designer who will take your work into high-fidelity design
  • Challenge assumptions constructively and improve product clarity early - before development begins
  • Communicate clearly with an international team in English , both written and spoken


Why this Role Might be a Fit

  • Have 5+ years of experience designing customer-facing SaaS products or complex web applications
  • Have worked on products that real customers use in production
  • Are comfortable designing multi-step workflows and role-based experiences
  • Understand how UX decisions impact usability, adoption, and real-world outcomes
  • Prefer focused, senior-level contribution over full-time availability
  • Are comfortable working independently with a high level of trust
  • Can overlap some working hours with PST
  • Communicate fluently in English


Preferred Background

While we care far more about what you’ve designed and shipped than your exact job title, this role is best suited to someone who has:

  • Designed complex SaaS or web applications used in production
  • Owned or heavily influenced end-to-end product experiences , not just individual screens
  • Worked closely with founders, product leaders, or engineering teams in small to mid-sized software companies
  • Designed workflows where clarity, trust, and correctness matter (e.g. healthcare, fintech, B2B, or data-heavy products)
  • Been accountable for experience decisions that had real user and business impact


If your experience is primarily marketing sites, brand work, or UI-only execution, this role is unlikely to be a fit.


Proof Matters

We strongly prefer candidates who can show real work, such as:

  • Screenshots of shipped SaaS products
  • Annotated flows or wireframes
  • Case studies explaining experience design decisions
  • Clear examples of problems you personally solved


We understand NDAs exist — but we’re looking for people who can point to real experience design work and talk concretely about the decisions behind it.


How to Apply

Apply via LinkedIn.


Please include:

  • A short note about your experience designing SaaS or web applications
  • Links to relevant work (portfolio, screenshots, case studies)
  • Anything that clearly shows how you shaped the product experience


Applications without clear experience in SaaS or web-based product design will not be considered.

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development


Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.


Location: Brazil


The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.



Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.


Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

7) Comunicação e trabalho em equipe : manter uma comunicação clara com os clientes e com a equipe, buscando soluções para eventuais problemas e colaborando com outras tarefas da loja, quando necessário.

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
About Us:

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.


The Role:

As Vendry’s Accounts Receivable Specialist , you’ll play a crucial operational and financial role ensuring that our revenue engine runs smoothly, accurately, and transparently. You’ll be responsible for managing our referral fee collection process—working directly with our agency partners to confirm contract terms, validate deal data, and ensure timely and accurate payments.


Beyond the core AR workflow, this role is also instrumental in strengthening Vendry’s internal financial operations. You’ll support our accounting processes, help categorize transactions correctly, maintain clean records across our systems, assist with P&L and reporting needs, and identify opportunities to streamline and improve how we operate as an organization.


This is a highly collaborative role that sits at the intersection of finance, operations, and partner relations. You’ll be a key part of ensuring Vendry is running efficiently, sustainably, and with complete clarity into our financial performance.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage the end-to-end accounts receivable process, including tracking referral-fee–eligible deals and verifying all contract and payment data with agency partners.
  • Collaborate with agencies to collect invoices, confirm terms, and reconcile discrepancies quickly and professionally.
  • Maintain accurate financial records and ensure all transactions are properly categorized in accounting systems.
  • Support monthly P&Ls, reporting workflows, and ad-hoc financial analysis as needed.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve Vendry’s internal financial processes, tools, and documentation.
  • Work closely with the Agency Operations and Leadership teams to ensure alignment between deal data, contract terms, and revenue expectations.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation in our internal systems to support transparency, compliance, and decision-making.
  • Assist with broader operational improvements as Vendry scales—including identifying bottlenecks, proposing solutions, and helping implement them.


Qualifications:


  • 2–4 years of experience in accounts receivable, financial operations, accounting support, or a similar role.
  • Strong understanding of basic accounting principles and AR best practices.
  • Excellent English proficiency (verbal and written) and strong communication skills, especially when working with U.S.-based teams and partners.
  • Experience working with U.S. startups, agencies, or marketing organizations is strongly preferred.
  • Comfort working with financial tools, spreadsheets, accounting platforms, and internal operations systems.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive—able to manage multiple workflows with accuracy and follow-through.
  • Experience working remotely; able to collaborate asynchronously and manage your own schedule effectively.
  • Based in Brazil and able to work full-time remotely.


Why Join Vendry:

Joining Vendry means becoming part of a fast-growing team committed to transforming how brands discover and work with top-tier agencies. You’ll play a foundational role in strengthening the systems that allow our business to scale—helping ensure our financial engine is accurate, efficient, and ready for growth.


We’re a collaborative, fast-moving team that values operational excellence, clear communication, and initiative. You’ll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact on how the company runs day-to-day, while building deep experience in finance and operations within a modern, tech-powered startup.


If you’re detail-driven, process-oriented, and excited about supporting a high-growth company through strong financial operations, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Exchange Administrator
description:

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Cloud Infrastructure Engineer

Contract: PJ

Duration: Open-ended

We are seeking a motivated DevOps Engineer to support cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. This role offers the opportunity to work with modern cloud-native technologies while contributing to reliable, scalable systems across multi-cloud platforms.

This is a contract position , open to remote candidates located in North or South America , and will report to a Senior Manager of DevOps Engineering .


What You’ll Do

  • Participate in a regular on-call rotation , responding to incidents reliably and professionally
  • Maintain and evolve AWS cloud infrastructure , leveraging automation and infrastructure-as-code
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform
  • Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines , enabling agile and self-service software delivery
  • Manage and support containerized applications running on Kubernetes
  • Collaborate closely with Software Engineers and other DevOps team members to solve complex technical problems
  • Quickly absorb technical context while ramping up in a dynamic environment
  • Contribute to best practices that enhance system reliability, scalability, and performance


Minimum Qualifications

  • 4–6 years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or a related role
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and/or GCP
  • Experience with relational databases (Postgres, MySQL, or similar)
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes
  • Experience with GitOps / CI/CD tools (e.g., Harness, Argo, Flux, Jenkins)
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)
  • Exposure to logging, monitoring, and observability tools such as:
  • Datadog
  • Prometheus
  • Grafana
  • ELK Stack
  • CloudWatch
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers working primarily in Pacific Time (PST)


Nice to Have

  • Experience developing automation or tooling using languages beyond shell scripting (e.g., Go, Python, Java, Elixir )
  • Experience building or supporting platform tooling for development, staging, or integration environments
  • Strong skills debugging performance or networking issues in Kubernetes-based applications

Home Alliance Venture Studio is building one of the fastest-growing ecosystems in the U.S.​ Our offer ranges from $1,000 → $100,000+ high-ticket programs , with a constant flow of highly qualified inbound leads​: 


  • Digital products ($1,000–$10,000)
  • Consulting & mentorship ($10,000–$40,000)
  • Franchise packages ($20,000–$100,000+)
  • Online academies & virtual education
  • SaaS subscriptions
  • AI products (AllianceVoice.ai, etc.)


Each product vertical will have 3–5 dedicated closers , and we are scaling aggressively.


About the role:


As a Remote Closer, you will handle qualified inbound leads generated through our marketing funnels. Your job is to consult prospects, understand their goals, and enroll them into the program or product that best fits their needs. This is NOT cold calling.


This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a performance-driven environment, communicates with clarity and empathy, and excels at closing digital product sales via Zoom or phone.


Responsibilities:

  • Conduct scheduled sales calls (Zoom or phone) with warm, pre-qualified leads.
  • Follow a proven sales framework while incorporating your own style.
  • Ask powerful questions to understand client goals, challenges, and fit.
  • Present the offer clearly and handle objections professionally.
  • Maintain accurate call notes and pipeline updates in the CRM.
  • Collaborate with the sales team for continuous improvement.
  • Meet or exceed weekly and monthly closing targets.
  • Uphold brand values and represent our company with integrity.


Requirements:

  • Minimum 1–2 years of closing experience, preferably in digital products (courses, coaching, SaaS, education, consulting).
  • ​Strong communication and emotional intelligence.
  • Confidence in leading consultative sales conversations.
  • Reliable internet connection and quiet workspace.
  • High ownership mindset and ability to work independently.
  • Coachable, growth-oriented, and comfortable receiving feedback.
  • Familiarity with CRMs (HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Close, or similar).


Preferred (Bonus)

  • Experience in high-ticket closing ($1k–$15k offers).
  • Understanding of online marketing funnels.
  • Background in personal development, business coaching, or tech.


Compensation

  • Commission-based  (industry-leading payouts)
  • OTE:

* $8,000–$20,000/month

* Top performers: $30,000–$50,000+/month

  • Upside based on productivity — no ceiling
  • Quick promotion for consistent closers
  • Opportunity for promotion to Senior Closer or Sales Lead.


What We Offer

  • Inbound, qualified leads (no cold calling).
  • A proven, in-demand digital product suite.
  • Weekly training, call reviews, and performance coaching.
  • Supportive, high-performance remote sales culture.
  • Flexible hours (within US time zones).​

title: Data Architect with AWS & Snowflake experience
description:
Title: Data Architect with AWS & Snowflake experience

Location: 100% Remote

Job Type: Contract


Responsibilities

• Technical Leadership: Provide technical direction and mentorship to a team of data engineers, ensuring best practices in coding, architecture, and data operations.

• End-to-End Ownership: Architect, implement, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines that process and transform large-scale datasets efficiently and reliably.

• Orchestration and Automation: Design scalable workflows using orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.

• Data Warehouse and Lake Optimization: Lead the implementation and optimization of Snowflake and data lake technologies like Apache Iceberg for storage, query performance, and scalability.

• Real-Time and Batch Processing: Build robust systems leveraging Kafka, SQS, or similar messaging technologies for real-time and batch data processing.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to define data requirements and deliver actionable insights.

• Data Governance and Security: Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and maintaining data integrity.

• Scalability and Performance: Develop strategies to optimize performance for systems processing terabytes of data daily while ensuring scalability.

• Team Building: Foster a collaborative team environment, driving skill development, career growth, and continuous learning within the team.

• Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Stay ahead of industry trends to evaluate and incorporate new tools, technologies, and methodologies into the organization.


Qualifications

Required Skills:

• 8+ years of experience in data engineering with a proven track record of leading data projects or teams.

• Strong programming skills in Python, with expertise in building and optimizing ETL pipelines.

• Extensive experience with Snowflake or equivalent data warehouses for designing schemas, optimizing queries, and managing large datasets.

• Expertise in orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, with experience in building and managing complex workflows.

• Deep understanding of messaging queues such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or similar technologies for real-time data ingestion and processing.

• Demonstrated ability to architect and implement scalable data solutions handling terabytes of data.

• Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg for managing and optimizing data lakes.

• Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and managing distributed systems.

• Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, including version control, deployment strategies, and automated testing.

• Proven experience working in an Agile development environment and managing cross-functional team interactions.

• Strong background in data modeling, data governance, and ensuring compliance with data security standards.

• Experience working with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Preferred Skills:

• Proficiency in stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink for real-time analytics.

• Familiarity with programming languages like Scala or Java for additional engineering tasks.

• Exposure to integrating data pipelines with machine learning workflows.

• Strong analytical skills to evaluate new technologies and tools for scalability and performance.

Leadership Skills:

• Proven ability to lead and mentor data engineering teams, promoting collaboration and a culture of excellence.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to articulate complex technical concepts to stakeholders.

Strategic thinking to align data engineering efforts with business goals and objectives.

Thanks

Aatmesh

In this role, you will work on our healthcare platform, gaining deep system knowledge and contributing to our Agile workflow via Azure DevOps . You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews , expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. Your role will evolve based on your strengths and our needs — all while adhering to rigorous coding and security standards .


Key Responsibilities

1. Product Design & Development

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to design software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.

title: Controls Engineer
description:
Build the Future of Automation as a Robotics Controls Engineer


We’re looking for a Robotics Controls Engineer who’s ready to take the lead in designing, programming, and optimizing cutting-edge robotic automation systems. In this hands-on role, you’ll bring bespoke robotic solutions to life, developing advanced control algorithms, integrating real-time systems, and delivering precision, performance, and reliability across industrial robot applications.


You’ll work side by side with mechanical, electrical, and production teams to create fully integrated automation solutions from concept to commissioning. From running simulations and performance testing to solving complex control challenges, your expertise will directly shape innovative, high-impact systems used in real-world environments.


This is an exciting opportunity for a controls engineer with 3+ years of industrial robot programming experience, a deep passion for automation, and the drive to push the boundaries of what robotic systems can achieve. If you’re eager to make a tangible impact on next-generation robotics, and see your work in action, this role is for you.


Key Responsibilities


  • Develop, implement, and optimise control algorithms for bespoke robotic systems.
  • Design and integrate control systems for real-time operation, ensuring precise and efficient movement, sensing, and interaction.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including mechanical design engineers, control engineers, and the production teams, to ensure seamless integration into our bespoke robotic automation & control systems.
  • Conduct simulations and testing to validate control algorithms, mechanical design, manipulator suitability and optimise performance to meet cycle time commitments.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve control system issues, ensuring smooth operation and reliability.
  • Stay updated with the latest advancements in robotics controls across multiple vendor platforms and identify opportunities for innovation and improvement.
  • Document design processes, specifications, and develop technical reports.


Qualifications:


  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3+ years experience with programming industrial robots is essential.
  • Strong background in robotics controls and demonstrated experience in developing control algorithms for robotic systems, experience with programming ABB robots is essential.
  • Familiarity and experience with robotic hardware platforms, PLC programming (Rockwell, Siemens, Omron etc), sensors, and actuators.
  • Solid understanding of control theory, including PID control, state-space control, and adaptive control.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex control system issues.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively in cross functional teams.
  • Experience with industrial automation, machine vision, or motion planning is desirable.

title: DevOps Pleno/Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma DevOps para fazer parte de nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de aplicações, desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega em produção, garantindo eficiência e agilidade por meio da automação e de metodologias ágeis.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

Seu dia-a-dia será dinâmico e desafiador, com atividades que envolvem desde o desenvolvimento de pipelines de integração e entrega contínuas, até a manutenção de infraestrutura cloud.

Você terá a oportunidade de atuar em empresas de grande porte, auxiliando a equipe a alcançar resultados mais rápidos e eficientes através da adoção de metodologias ágeis e da automação de processos. Incluindo atividades como:

  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes de infraestrutura cloud.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de infraestrutura como código (IaC), utilizando ferramentas como Terraform, CloudFormation ou Azure Resource Manager.
  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD, automatizando processos de integração e entrega contínuas.
  • Criar e manter scripts de automação para tarefas rotineiras e de configuração.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua no processo de entrega de software e implementação de otimizações.
  • Resolver incidentes e problemas de produção de maneira rápida e eficaz, garantindo a estabilidade dos sistemas.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares e comunicar-se efetivamente com outras áreas da empresa.


Resultados esperados incluem a otimização do tempo de desenvolvimento, a redução do tempo de lançamento de nova versões em produção e a melhoria contínua do processo de entrega de software. Exemplos de entregáveis incluem a configuração e manutenção de ambientes de infraestrutura cloud, o desenvolvimento de scripts de automação de tarefas e pipelines de CI/CD, além da resolução de incidentes e problemas de produção.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:

  • Experiência com plataformas de orquestração de containers, como Kubernetes, Docker Swarm ou Openshift
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de configuração, como Ansible, Puppet e Chef
  • Experiência em linguagens de programação, como Python, Ruby ou Go, para automatizar tarefas e desenvolver pipelines de CI/CD
  • Conhecimento em práticas DevOps e metodologias ágeis
  • Familiaridade com infraestruturas cloud, como AWS, Azure ou GCP
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento (Observabilidade) e gerenciamento de LOGs, como Datadog, NewRelic, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana e Elasticsearch
  • Experiência com a prática de infraestrutura como código, utilizando ferramentas como Terraform, CloudFormation e/ou Azure Resource Manager para provisionar e gerenciar infraestrutura cloud.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.

Suporte técnico e melhoria contínua

- Apoiar tecnicamente as áreas de Engenharia, Produção, Garantia da Qualidade e Validação.

- Promover a melhoria contínua dos processos de qualificação, propondo soluções baseadas em análise crítica de dados e tendências.

title: Account Executive - B2B SaaS
description:
About the Role

We’re hiring high-performing B2B SaaS Account Executives based in LATAM who want full ownership of their number and unlimited earning potential.

This is a role for builders, not order-takers. You’ll own the entire sales cycle, work directly with US-based customers, and be rewarded on performance. If you believe sales is the fastest path to growth, autonomy, and income, this role is for you.


About Lilo

Lilo is rebuilding procurement for Commercial Real Estate using AI.

Hotels and CRE operators still manage procurement with emails, calls, spreadsheets, and tribal knowledge. Lilo replaces that chaos with a single AI-powered platform that automates purchasing, vendor management, invoice processing, and price optimization.

We work with major hotel management companies and staple hotel brands in the US, and we’re in an explosive growth path. Top performers have outsized impact and ownership.


What You’ll Do

  • Own the entire outbound sales motion : prospecting, discovery, demo, close with US-based customers
  • Represent Lilo at industry events and network your way to high profile decision makers
  • Build and manage a pipeline of C-level operators, hotel owners, and decision-makers
  • Navigate consultative, multi-stakeholder sales cycles
  • Work closely with onboarding and product to ensure long-term customer success


What We’re Looking For

  • Excellent written and spoken English (C2 level)
  • Up to 5 years of experience in B2B SaaS sales (closing role, not SDR-only)
  • Proven track record owning full sales cycles
  • Strong outbound prospecting skills (email, LinkedIn, calls)
  • Experience selling to US-based customers
  • Comfortable working remotely with high independence
  • Competitive, performance-driven mindset


Compensation & Upside

  • Base salary: US$2,500/Mo.
  • On Target Commission: $2,500+/Mo. (50/50 split)
  • Total OTE: $5,000+/Mo.
  • Uncapped commissions + boosters
  • ESOP package with high potential upside

The harder you grind, the more you make.


Who Should NOT Apply

This role is not for you if:

  • You are not confident selling in English to US customers
  • You want a passive, inbound-only sales role
  • You need heavy structure, scripts, or constant supervision
  • You’re uncomfortable picking up the phone, doing outbound outreach, and rejection
  • You’re looking for a slow-moving, corporate environment


Why Lilo?

  • Fully remote role with a fast-growing, US-based startup
  • USD compensation with uncapped upside
  • Direct exposure to high profile US-based customers
  • Fast-moving startup with real ownership and accountability
  • Early-stage opportunity with real revenue ownership and ESOP upside
  • Performance-first compensation with uncapped upside
  • Ambitious, low-ego, execution-focused team
  • Exposure to AI, SaaS, and hospitality at scale

description:

In-office in Rio de Janeiro

About the Project

A leading content creation & marketing platform for K-12 athletic departments, schools, and districts in the U.S., trusted by thousands of customers across all 50 states. One of the key products is interactive touchscreen displays that showcase a school’s awards, records, and history.


About the Role

As a Launch Specialist, you will be the first to welcome a newly signed school or athletic department to Touch and guide them through a smooth, high-quality launch. You’ll manage multiple customer accounts at different onboarding stages, collect required assets, confirm setup details, and build much of the initial Touch site yourself (pages, content, layouts) to ensure the display is accurate, visually polished, and ready for launch—then support a seamless handoff to Customer Success.


Requirements

- Ability to effectively manage multiple customer accounts, each at different stages of the onboarding journey;

- Growth mindset: you’re a lifelong learner who’s committed to continuous professional growth and development;

- Solutions-oriented with a strong sense of ownership; you can identify issues and take appropriate action;

- Hunger for a fast-paced environment where priorities evolve, change is standard, and flexibility is a must;

- Strong design sense with the ability to create clean, organized, and visually polished Touch sites;

- Excellent English fluency, including reading, writing, and verbal communication (C1/C2 proficiency preferred);

- Prior experience in a customer-facing role (1+ year) is a plus;

- Ability to work U.S. Eastern Time business hours and be in-office five days per week.


Responsibilities

- Welcome newly signed schools or athletic departments to Touch and guide customers through a smooth, high-quality launch;

- Manage a portfolio of partners in different stages of the onboarding journey; collect required assets and confirm setup details;

- Build much of the initial Touch site: structuring pages, organizing content, configuring layouts, and ensuring accuracy and completeness;

- Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams to resolve questions, remove blockers, and keep launches moving forward on schedule;

- Manage a high volume of inbound and outbound emails, Zoom meetings, and calls; answer questions and set timelines;

- Log all activity in Salesforce and ensure a seamless handoff to the Customer Success team after a successful launch.


We offer

- Mentorship and career growth: Learn directly from experienced B2B SaaS leaders, with a clear path for professional development across a variety of roles in support, sales, and customer success;

- Ownership and impact: Take responsibility for real outcomes and see your work make a difference for thousands of organizations;

- Startup experience: Gain hands-on exposure to how a fast-growing SaaS company operates;

- In-office in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil (five days per week).

title: Data Visualization Specialist
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Role Summary:

We are looking for a technical builder to own our data visualization layer. You will develop custom, interactive data products for our customers using Shiny for Python and maintain rapid internal reporting using Looker Studio.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Data Visualization Product Development (Shiny for Python)
  • Architect, build, and deploy production-grade, highly-interactive data applications for customer-facing delivery using the Shiny for Python framework.
  • Lead the full development lifecycle, encompassing the design of intuitive user interfaces (UI) and the implementation of robust, performant server-side logic and reactivity.
  • Implement best practices for code quality, testing, modularization (e.g., Shiny modules), and deployment on platforms like Posit Connect to ensure a reliable and scalable data product experience.
  • Business Intelligence and Internal Reporting Management
  • Serve as the owner and subject matter expert for the internal Business Intelligence environment, primarily utilizing Looker Studio.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated dashboards and reports that deliver timely and actionable insights to internal stakeholders, effectively replacing manual reporting processes.
  • Apply advanced BI techniques, including the creation of complex calculated fields and data blending, to integrate diverse datasets for a unified view of performance.
  • Data Querying and Performance Optimization
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain efficient, production-ready SQL queries, leveraging advanced techniques such as Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and window functions.
  • Actively manage the performance layer of data visualization products, ensuring both Shiny applications and Looker Studio reports execute quickly and maintain responsiveness under anticipated data volumes and user load.
  • Collaborate closely with Data Engineering teams to understand and leverage the underlying data warehouse structure (e.g., Python, SQL).
  • User Experience (UX) and Data Design
  • Translate complex, multi-dimensional datasets into clean, visually compelling, and intuitive user experiences, moving beyond simple table and chart outputs to sophisticated data narratives.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all data products, focusing on design principles that enhance data comprehension and drive user adoption.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Aesthetic and Design Acumen: Ability to translate complex analytical findings into beautiful, polished, and intuitive visualizations, evidenced by a strong public portfolio.
  • Technical Agility: Proficiency in the core Tech Stack, including Python, SQL, Posit Connect, Looker Studio, and Git.
  • Self-Direction and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a visualization portfolio autonomously, proactively identify and implement improvements, and take ownership of the data visualization layer.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively deal with technical ambiguities and continuously seek process improvements in data product delivery.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and present complex data concepts clearly.


Requirements:

  • At least 1 year of hands-on experience working with Shiny for Python or similar interactive visualization frameworks such as Plotly, Dash, or Shiny for R , including building interactive dashboards and understanding core concepts like reactivity and UI/server architecture.
  • Expert BI Tool Experience: Strong, hands-on experience with Looker Studio, particularly in data blending, custom calculations, and connecting to various data sources.
  • Advanced SQL Skills: Demonstrated ability to write complex, performant SQL queries (using CTEs, window functions, and advanced joins) for data manipulation and preparation prior to visualization.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Familiarity with other data visualization libraries in Python (e.g., Plotly, Dash) to complement Shiny.
  • Experience with other BI platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in a quantitative or technical field.
  • 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on data visualization development, BI reporting, or data product creation, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

title: Content Specialist
description:
Our purpose


ecoPortal health and safety engagement software helps organisations amplify workplace safety. We give leaders the data they need to create awe-inspiring safety cultures that ignite their team’s potential.


Engaged teams are the beating heart of industry-leading, odds-defying workplaces, and we’re committed to helping clients achieve that.


Our mission is simple: create engaged cultures and healthier environments for all.

Who we are


We’re a real tech success story, built from the ground up with a vision of transforming the health and safety industry as we know it.


Through our years, we’re anchored by our commitment to championing people. That commitment begins from the ground up... with our own team.


Our team culture is an organic creation built by our people, for our people. Differences are celebrated here, and we firmly believe that our diverse lived experiences work together to make us stronger as a whole.



The Opportunity


The Content Specialist is an exciting role in ecoPortal’s marketing team, directly contributing to our content strategy. You’ll be part of a team with big aspirations, changing perceptions of health and safety worldwide.



Ideal for someone who has:


  • A Bachelors (or higher) Degree in marketing/ journalism/ communications or similar major.
  • Exceptional written and verbal English fluency.
  • A strong understanding of SEO and CRO copywriting.
  • A flair for story-telling, with the ability to demonstrate technical writing.
  • A passion for writing with an excellent eye for detail, grammar, brand tone and style.
  • Experience in marketing in a tech and/or SaaS company is an advantage.
  • An understanding of the buyer journey and how best to capture people's interest at each stage.
  • Experience in managing Podcasts, Webinars and live content events.
  • The ability to meet deadlines, be a self-starter and have a can-do attitude.
  • Great communication skills, with the ability to liaise with both internal and external stakeholders regularly.


Key Responsibilities


  • Execution of the company’s content strategy, with the aim of educating, engaging, entertaining and empowering people across the company’s full customer lifecycle.
  • Be a driving force behind the execution of a broad range of top-notch content including ad campaigns, web copy, email marketing, blogs, case studies, webinars, event collateral, videos and more.
  • Planning webinar and podcast series and managing all production aspects, from prospecting and inviting potential speakers to writing briefings and scripts and supporting the recording or live delivery.
  • Creation of compelling monthly and quarterly newsletters, with ongoing performance tracking and a focus on finding new ways to improve engagement.
  • Keep your finger on the pulse of what’s front of mind for professionals in the world of health and safety and use that to input on content and campaign idea generation.
  • Support the Sales and Success teams by creating targeted collateral, emails, social posts and case studies to drive conversions and upsell opportunities;
  • Support the company’s SEO initiatives, scope and create content that helps the company get found via organic traffic;
  • Contribute to ecoPortal’s content strategy and execution.
  • Take a campaign approach to content development. Implement SEO best practices, test, and iterate your content and creative processes with the aim of increasing ecoPortal’s reach, generating demand, and converting prospects to customers.
  • Support other team-wide initiatives with targeted collateral (i.e. web, email) that leverages strong storytelling to get key ecoPortal messages across in inspiring and unique ways;
  • Keep your work in Trello and the content calendar up-to-date and set up other administrative processes as required;
  • Closely monitor new content trends, and proactively seek creative opportunities where these can be best utilised at the company.
  • Own and manage our content partnership relationships, agreements and event partner content.
  • Collaborate with other Creative Team members, including Graphic Designers, Video Specialists, as well as members of the Digital Marketing Team.
  • Contribute to brand and content reporting as required.
  • Support the Content Marketing Manager and wider marketing team in other areas of the business that align with your skillset as required.



Perks & Benefits:


We hope that you're excited by the possibilities that come with working at ecoPortal! In addition to our welcoming and diverse culture, we also offer these fun perks and benefits.


37-Hour Work Week & Flexible Working: We prioritise work-life balance by offering a 37-hour workweek and flexible working arrangements. Some of your working hours will be aligned with the New Zealand time zone to ensure collaboration with the team.


⛺️ Generous Annual Leave


Birthday Perk: You get to take your birthday off! If it falls on a weekend, you can choose a day close to your birthday to celebrate. Milestone Birthdays are celebrated extra special with ecoPortal.


End-of-Year Celebration: Enter the draw for a chance to join the team at ecoPortal HQ in New Zealand for our epic end-of-year celebrations! The longer you’ve been with eP, the more entries you get. We've got flights, accommodation, and meals all covered while you’re here. ✈️ ️


Professional Development: ecoPortal offer financial assistance for Business English Language Courses, apps, or training.

description:

I. A Missão da Posição

O Especialista de Design (Shoes) possui um perfil híbrido, sendo responsável por todo o ciclo do calçado: desde a concepção criativa e estética (estilista) até a tradução técnica e funcional do produto (designer)2. Sua missão é garantir o equilíbrio entre a identidade de moda athleisure e a viabilidade produtiva, atuando de forma estratégica para que cada modelo seja, simultaneamente, um objeto de desejo e uma solução técnica de alta performance. Ele atua como o elo central entre o conceito criativo e o produto acabado, servindo como referência técnica e estética para o time.


II. Responsabilidades Principais

  • Criação e Tradução de Design: Propor conceitos criativos, temas e cartelas de cores, traduzindo-os em desenhos técnicos e especificações detalhadas para a construção de calçados.
  • Pesquisa e Inovação em Materiais: Realizar pesquisas de tendências globais e comportamento do consumidor, focando na aplicação de materiais tecnológicos e tecidos sintéticos voltados para alta performance.
  • Desenvolvimento e Refinamento Técnico: Atuar diretamente com Sourcing e Fornecedores no desenvolvimento de fôrmas, solados e componentes, garantindo que a proposta estética original seja mantida durante o processo de prototipagem e provas de calce.
  • Interface Estratégica: Colaborar de forma integrada com as áreas de Produto, Comercial e Produção para assegurar que o design respeite a viabilidade técnica e as metas de margem do negócio.
  • Guardião da Identidade e Ergonomia: Garantir a consistência visual das linhas de calçados, zelando pela qualidade estética e pela ergonomia, assegurando que o produto final reflita o DNA da marca.
  • Análise de Evolução de Produto: Monitorar a performance de vendas e o feedback de mercado para retroalimentar o processo criativo com melhorias contínuas no mix de produtos.


III. Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Experiência Profissional: Experiência consolidada atuando no ciclo completo de calçados (estilo e design técnico) em marcas de moda, sportswear ou acessórios.
  • Domínio Técnico-Criativo: Profundo conhecimento em processos de fabricação, materiais têxteis/sintéticos e habilidade técnica para leitura e criação de fichas e componentes.
  • Vivência em Chão de Fábrica: Experiência prática no acompanhamento de produção e desenvolvimento junto a fornecedores.
  • Habilidades Analíticas: Capacidade de traduzir o conceito da marca em produtos funcionais, equilibrando olhar apurado com as necessidades comerciais do mercado.
  • Formação: Graduação em Design de Produto, Moda, Design de Moda ou áreas correlatas.


IV. Diferenciais

  • Experiência específica no desenvolvimento de sneakers ou calçados utilitários para o nicho Athleisure.
  • Capacidade de transitar com agilidade entre a criação artística e o rigor técnico do design.
  • Vivência em ambientes de alta escala com múltiplas coleções e fluxos dinâmicos de lançamento.
  • Conhecimento em análise de dados de mercado voltados especificamente para o setor de calçados.

As a Cloud Infrastructure SRE / Tier 4 Engineer , you will join a specialized engineering task force dedicated to preventing and resolving the most critical and strategic customer issues encountered in the field.

Our global team of experienced engineers has a deep understanding of the lower layers of private cloud infrastructure. Together, we work on practical solutions, continuously learning and adapting. We collaborate closely, share knowledge, and tackle challenges head-on.

If you're an engineer eager to understand the core of cloud technologies and looking for a team that values hands-on expertise , you'll fit right in with us.


What you will learn and contribute to

  • Maintain and enhance Red Hat private cloud: You’ll work extensively with Nokia Container Services (NCS) and CloudBand Infrastructure Software (CBIS) , private cloud solutions based on Kubernetes and OpenStack .
  • Deep Dive Troubleshooting: Starting from high-level Kubernetes error messages, you’ll navigate through multiple layers until pinpointing issues—even down to kernel-level bugs.
  • Automate and Develop: Spend 30–50% of your time developing automation to prevent recurring issues. Solve it once, automate for the future. Use your Python skills to create health checks and improve reliability.
  • Continuous Learning: In our rapidly evolving tech landscape, ongoing learning is a cornerstone.
  • Collaborate with Developers and Engineers: Work closely with developers and product engineers to bridge infrastructure and software, ensuring seamless product delivery.
  • Mode of Operation: This role requires participation in a follow-the-sun scheme with 12-hour shifts (within regulatory limits) or participation in on-call rotations to ensure business continuity during emergencies.


Your skills and experience

  • Linux Expertise: Strong familiarity with Linux distributions; we primarily use Red Hat and CentOS .
  • Networking Foundations: Solid understanding of networking fundamentals (VLANs, IP routing). Experience with Calico , Multus , and Open vSwitch is a plus.
  • Problem-Solving Mindset: Excellent troubleshooting skills and analytical thinking to address complex challenges.
  • Scripting and Automation: Proficiency in Bash and Python , or willingness to learn, plus familiarity with Ansible .
  • Containerization & Virtualization: Knowledge of Podman , Kubernetes , Helm , and/or OpenStack ; experience with KVM/QEMU is advantageous.
  • Storage Systems: Experience with Ceph and Rook is highly valued.
  • Database Expertise: Understanding of relational databases (MySQL , MariaDB ) and experience with etcd .
  • Monitoring and Logging: Familiarity with tools like ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) , Prometheus , and Grafana .
  • Advanced written and spoken English.


It would be nice if you also had

  • Proactive thinking and ownership mindset.
  • Strong focus on quality and reliability.
  • Passion for delivering training or knowledge-sharing sessions to operations teams.



Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

Somos uma consultoria especializada em recrutamento e seleção para o ecossistema de startups e empresas de tecnologia. Atualmente, atendemos mais de 50 clientes, que vão desde early-stage, empresas seed-invested e startups Series A/B/C/D até grandes multinacionais.


O ano de 2025 foi ótimo para nós, crescemos 155% e mais que dobramos nosso time de operações!

Principais responsabilidades

Requisitos

  • Formação: Nos importamos mais com experiência prática do que formação superior.
  • Experiência: Sólida em executive/tech search, conduzindo de 8 a 12 vagas simultâneas de nível sênior e gerencial, com foco na qualidade da entrega e evitando ser “impressora de currículos”. Foco em recrutamento estratégico e com entrega rápida/efetiva. Nosso SLA de entrega são 5 dias úteis, e nossa taxa de fechamento é entre 3 - 6 indicados.


Perfil

  • Altamente organizado e orientado a resultados
  • Excelente comunicação interpessoal
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em ritmo acelerado
  • Resiliência à pressão e postura hands-on
  • Curioso: Nosso perfil é pesquisar sobre vagas, criar estratégias de hunting ground, conseguir ter base para entrevistar candidatos de forma qualificada.
  • Somos uma empresa jovem, com cultura dinâmica, rápida, e anti-burocrática. Se você se identifica com essa linha, será bem-vindo.


Infraestrutura

  • Computador próprio e conexão de internet estável


O que não se alinha com o nosso jeito de trabalhar

  • Dificuldade em lidar com ritmo intenso e alta pressão: Nosso dia a dia é acelerado e está em constante transformação. Quem precisa de supervisão constante, tem dificuldade com pressão ou busca um ambiente previsível pode não se adaptar bem aqui.
  • Ausência de senso de responsabilidade e rejeição à autonomia: Esperamos postura de dono: tomar decisões, assumir riscos e gerar resultados. Quem depende de orientação constante ou busca validação o tempo todo provavelmente não terá espaço. Aqui, o protagonismo é essencial e valorizado com participação nos resultados.
  • Resistência a feedbacks francos e cultura de transparência: Prezamos pela clareza e sinceridade. Feedbacks são recorrentes e parte do nosso desenvolvimento. Isso exige maturidade para aceitar críticas construtivas com abertura e humildade.
  • Apego a horários fixos: Somos uma consultoria em expansão acelerada. Problemas surgem a qualquer momento, e as soluções também. Valorizamos quem entrega com excelência mesmo que isso demande flexibilidade de agenda.


Pacote de remuneração

  • Salário Fixo PJ
  • Variável mensal: potencial médio de R$ 4.500 – 12.000 (com atingimento de meta mensal, é esperado R$6.500 - 9.000), sem teto.

Buscamos uma pessoa com visão arquitetural e experiência em alta escalabilidade para elevar o nível técnico do nosso time. Você terá papel fundamental na definição de padrões de engenharia e na construção de sistemas robustos que impactam diretamente a eficiência do setor de saúde.


O que você irá fazer no dia-a-dia?


Sua missão vai além de escrever código: você será uma referência técnica dentro da Carefy.


  • Interface Técnica com Clientes: Atuar como ponto focal em reuniões com os times de TI dos clientes (operadoras de saúde) para alinhar requisitos de integração, layouts de dados e especificações de API;

  • Padronização e Performance: Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e identificar gargalos de performance em cenários de alto volume de dados.


Qual o contexto?


Você fará parte do nosso time de integração. Somos os responsáveis pela interoperabilidade da Carefy. Nossa missão é conectar nossa plataforma aos ecossistemas heterogêneos das operadoras de saúde, garantindo que os dados fluam com segurança e performance. Neste time, você atuará como referência técnica : participando diretamente do desenho de soluções junto aos times de TI dos clientes e, internamente, traduzindo esses desafios complexos em uma arquitetura limpa e em demandas organizadas para orientar o desenvolvimento.

Quais são os requisitos?


  • Mínimo de 6 anos de experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Experiência de 4+ anos com Node.js e TypeScript em produção;
  • Experiência de 4+ anos Bancos de Dados Relacionais (MySQL) , incluindo modelagem e otimização;

  • Experiência prática com Cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) e serviços de Mensageria (RabbitMQ/Kafka) ;

  • Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2).


O que oferecemos?

title: Tax Coordinator
description:
The Regional Tax Coordinator will support the global tax function with end‑to‑end ownership of multi‑jurisdiction tax compliance, controversy, and operational readiness. The role encompasses direct and indirect taxes, withholding tax and treaty management, transfer pricing oversight, and implementation of new global regimes such as Pillar Two.

The coordinator will drive strategic tax planning initiatives that optimize the effective tax rate and cash taxes while ensuring robust compliance, operational substance, and scalable controls and automation. This position partners closely with finance, controllership, treasury, legal, and business teams to support new transactions, products, and market entries and to proactively assess permanent establishment and nexus risks.


RESPONSABILITIES

i. Ensures timely and accurate tax compliance across all in‑scope jurisdictions, including corporate income taxes, indirect taxes such as VAT, GST, ICMS, and ISS, and withholding tax returns and information reporting.

ii. The role owns the global tax calendar and filing controls, establishing standard operating procedures and clear accountabilities to maintain a consistently high on time filing rate and audit readiness.

iii. Map tax opportunities and risks, proposing and implementing tax planning initiatives and corporate restructurings aimed at tax efficiency and reduction of the overall tax burden.

iv. Act in a consultative capacity with business areas, treasury, and controllership, providing support on tax-related matters and new transactions.

v. Monitor changes in local and international tax legislation and ensure the implementation of internal improvements to comply with new regulations.

vi. Lead internal and external tax audits and inspections with authorities in Brazil and other jurisdictions, managing controversy strategies and external advisors to achieve efficient, defensible outcomes.

vii. Analyze due diligence reports and provide support for strategic projects, such as the development of new products and M&A transactions.

viii. Develop and monitor robust internal controls to mitigate tax risks.

ix. Prepare reports and documentation to support senior management in tax-related matters.


QUALIFICATIONS

i. Bachelor’s degree in accounting, law or related area

ii. Minimum 8 years of experience, (Big 4 or public company experience preferred)

iii. Language: English, advanced / Spanish, desirable


REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

i. Strong knowledge of global tax laws, cross-border regulations, and transfer pricing principles.

ii. Proficiency with tax preparation software and ERP.

iii. Experience with Financial institutions is desirable


SOFT SKILLS

title: Product Designer
description:
For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Designer to own the end-to-end user experience for our Carnegie Audiences suite of products (careerexplorer.com and supplemental products), including the integration and design of new Agentic AI interactions. You will be responsible for translating complex user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant, and effective design solutions. This role requires a strong focus on core user experience, user flows, and wireframing, in addition to high-quality visual user interface (UI) execution.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • User Experience (UX) Strategy and Design
  • Lead the design process from initial concept and user research through to final implementation and iteration, focusing on complex user flows, information architecture, and system design.
  • Develop and refine wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to communicate design intent and test hypotheses with users and stakeholders.
  • Conduct usability testing, analyze user data, and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement of the product experience.
  • Design and integrate Agentic AI experiences into product flows, ensuring a seamless, trustworthy, and effective interaction between the user and the AI system.
  • User Interface (UI) Design and Visual Execution
  • Create polished, high-fidelity visual designs and detailed design specifications that adhere to brand guidelines and accessibility standards.
  • Maintain and contribute to our existing Design System, ensuring consistency, scalability, and efficiency across all product touchpoints.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all product outputs, focusing on design principles that enhance clarity and drive user adoption.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Implementation
  • Partner closely with Product Managers to define product strategy and requirements, ensuring design solutions align with business objectives and technical constraints.
  • Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure accurate design implementation and a seamless, high-quality user experience post-launch.
  • Participate in agile development processes, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and design critiques.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • UX/UI Acumen: Exceptional ability to translate strategic product goals into logical user flows and visually compelling, intuitive user interfaces, evidenced by a strong public portfolio of work on consumer-facing web products.
  • Technical Design Proficiency: Expertise in current design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) for creating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and specifications.
  • Design Ownership and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a design portfolio autonomously, proactively identify design opportunities, and take ownership of the product’s end-to-end user experience.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively navigate complex design challenges and continuously seek elegant solutions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively present design rationale to non-technical stakeholders and facilitate productive design critiques.


Requirements:

  • Advanced Proficiency in UX Design: Deep expertise in the full lifecycle of UX design, including user research, wireframing, journey mapping, and developing interactive prototypes that demonstrate complex user flows.
  • Expert UI/Visual Design Experience: Strong, hands-on experience in high-fidelity visual design, typography, color theory, and creating/maintaining design systems for web products.
  • Consumer Web Focus: Demonstrated ability to design and launch successful consumer-facing products on the web.
  • Portfolio: Mandatory submission of a portfolio (e.g., personal website, Dribbble, GitHub) that clearly demonstrates a focus on design thinking, user flows, and high-end aesthetic execution for consumer web applications.


Nice-to-haves:

  • AI/ML Design: Experience designing user experiences for AI/ML-powered features or familiarity with the principles of Agentic AI.
  • Familiarity with motion design and animation principles to enhance user interactions.
  • Proficiency with front-end code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript frameworks) to facilitate better collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in Design, HCI, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on Product Design (UX/UI) for consumer-facing web applications, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

What We Offer:

  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!

title: Designer de roupas
description:
Design de Produto (moda athleisure)

Localização: Rio de Janeiro – RJ


I. A Missão da Posição

O Especialista de Design (Lifestyle) é o responsável estratégico por traduzir conceitos e ideias criativas em produtos técnicos viáveis e desejáveis. Atuando como o braço técnico da área de Estilo, sua missão é transformar os direcionamentos estéticos em especificações precisas, garantindo que a identidade da marca de Athleisure seja preservada desde o desenho inicial até o produto acabado. Ele atua como uma referência técnica, assegurando que cada peça de vestuário combine inovação estética com rigor funcional e comercial.


II. Responsabilidades Principais

  • Tradução e Desenvolvimento Técnico: Converter conceitos criativos e temas propostos pelo Estilista em desenhos técnicos, modelagens e acabamentos detalhados para as coleções.
  • Pesquisa Aplicada de Materiais: Realizar pesquisas de materiais e referências de mercado para viabilizar tecnicamente as tendências e comportamentos de consumo identificados.
  • Acompanhamento de Prototipagem: Atuar em parceria direta com as áreas de Produto, Modelagem e Sourcing, acompanhando ajustes, amostras e validações técnicas até a aprovação final das peças.
  • Interface de Viabilidade: Trabalhar de forma integrada com Comercial, Marketing e Produção para garantir que a tradução do design respeite a viabilidade técnica e os objetivos de negócio.
  • Guardião da Consistência Criativa: Zelar pela qualidade técnica e consistência estética das coleções, garantindo que o produto final reflita fielmente a identidade visual da marca.
  • Ajuste de Performance: Utilizar feedbacks de mercado e análises de performance das coleções para aplicar melhorias técnicas contínuas no desenvolvimento de novos produtos.


III. Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Experiência Profissional: Experiência consolidada em design de produto ou posições técnicas em moda, com foco em sportswear ou athleisure.
  • Domínio Técnico Avançado: Profundo conhecimento em processos de desenvolvimento, construção de vestuário, materiais tecnológicos e leitura/execução de fichas técnicas detalhadas.
  • Vivência em Suprimentos: Experiência prática no acompanhamento de produção e relacionamento técnico com fornecedores.
  • Habilidades de Tradução Criativa: Capacidade de converter conceitos abstratos em soluções de design comerciais e funcionais com rigor estético.
  • Formação: Graduação em Moda, Design de Moda, Desenho Industrial ou áreas correlatas.


IV. Diferenciais

  • Experiência em traduzir coleções de alta escala e múltiplas entradas sazonais.
  • Vivência em marcas de moda lifestyle que exijam alto nível de detalhamento técnico.
  • Capacidade de atuar como referência técnica dentro do time de estilo para viabilização de novos produtos.
  • Conhecimento em análise de dados de performance de produto para otimização do design.
