title: Senior Training Facilitator
description:
Position: Senior Training Facilitator

Sector: Corporate Training – Service, Sales, Core job & interpersonal skills

Company: Global Partners Training, Cambridge, MA

Work Location: Global On-Site/Virtual


Position Overview:

This is an ideal role for a mid-late career executive who believes passionately in the power of relationships, not just to drive business results, but also to make the world a better place.


GPT has active relationships and is chasing multi-year deals with large multinationals for training services in a wide array of countries in EMEA, APAC and the Americas. The company is seeking to expand its training capacity by locating qualified facilitators, to whom the company will provide complete training and onboarding.


This is a part-time project-driven role, and availability for GPT work with reasonable advance notice of facilitation opportunities is required. This is a non-salaried position, and so the candidate should have an entrepreneurial mindset and background. Once a facilitation project is identified, the candidate must plan initially to spend several hours, sometimes a few days, to engage with the onboarding & train-the-trainer process. While there is no cash cost for candidate to engage (GPT invests in the onboarding & train-the-trainer process), candidate must have the financial capacity that allows time for onboarding before facilitation work can ramp to provide income.


Candidate will ideally have a mature background culminating as a senior manager/executive in service operations, sales, project management or learning and development in a B2B environment. Former training facilitation experience is desirable but is not required. Experience with professional coaching is a plus. Candidate should be very comfortable leading highly interactive sessions in both face-to-face and virtual formats. Candidate will need to demonstrate a clear understanding of the application of training to business objectives, combined with the persistence and patience to maintain communications with trainees and bring out the best in each person. Candidate will also have strong references attesting attention to detail, imperative for executing multi-event training logistics.


Responsibilities:

  • Take ownership of learning GPT program(s) fully and fluently, including watching videos, practicing solo, doing training dry-runs, responding positively to feedback, learning required technical aspects, executing required logistics, and keeping up with updates.
  • Adhere to GPT policies regarding facilitation work, including timely logistics requirements and data security, as stated in the contract as well as on the company’s internal website.
  • Support training groups, managers, sponsors and trainees in such a manner as to maintain every client as a referenceable account.
  • Professionally introduce and represent the company to prospects, clients and partners. (optional)
  • Provide regular and meaningful insights to GPT regarding training observations, new sales opportunities and potential competition.
  • Support GPT peers in developing a culture of empathy, customer focus, team spirit and fun that values mutual success and the highest standards of professionalism.
  • Balance assertiveness with being an excellent team player.


Requirements:

  • 10+ years in relevant senior management role(s) that gives insight into industry, corporate training and prospective trainees.
  • Strong understanding of the application of corporate training to achieve business results.
  • Desired track record of facilitation in face-to-face and virtual formats or the ability to learn quickly.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with all levels of the customer: Technical, L&D, Financial and Executive.
  • Strong ability to facilitate training programs in English and the working local language(s) in your region.
  • Comfortable using technical systems, such as video-conferencing software, digital collaboration platforms, face-to-face systems such as laptop/projector interface, as well as CRM, LMS and other company information systems.
  • Exceptional empathy, interpersonal, writing and presentation skills.
  • Proactivity and thriving in a fast-paced, changing environment.
  • Autonomy and ability to get the job done without being prompted while managing local engagements.
  • Balancing ambition and drive with a high level of integrity.
  • Fun to be around, personable!


Compensation includes facilitation fees and opportunities for quality bonuses, as well as longer-term opportunities if interested for sales commissions and new client bonuses.


About Global Partners Training:

Global Partners Training (GPT) is a private, fast-growing provider of outsourced training programs to some of the largest global service companies in the high technology, health care, telecommunications, energy and industrial sectors. Regardless of the practical training topic, GPT’s wide array of proprietary training modules and programs deliver exceptional business results by targeting more productive interpersonal relationships among external and internal stakeholders across the workforce (field service, global shared services, sales, product, project, executive), and training effectiveness is demonstrated through an innovative process called Validated Behavior Change.

About Us

  • Q Global Network (QGN): A global serviced apartment agency working with suppliers around the world.
  • Aeria Apartments: A London-based serviced apartment provider.
  • QDK: Q Apartments Denmark, offering stress-free beginnings in and around Copenhagen


Together, we provide premium, fully furnished apartments for business and leisure travellers worldwide. Our mission is to deliver a seamless “home away from home” experience with unparalleled service, comfort, and convenience.


Although this position focuses on QDK, there is close cross-team collaboration across all three companies’ Guest Experience teams, ensuring we share knowledge, best practices, and consistently deliver exceptional service to both guests and suppliers.

The Global Guest Experience Coordinator is responsible for delivering a seamless, high-quality guest journey from pre-arrival to check-out, acting as the main point of contact for guest communication and support. The role combines exceptional customer service with effective problem-solving, ensuring issues are handled quickly, empathetically, and professionally.


Working closely with internal teams (including reservations, sales, operations, supply, and finance) and external partners such as approved suppliers, landlords, and managing agents worldwide, you will coordinate services, manage escalations, and help maintain consistent standards across the guest experience. You will also gather and analyse guest feedback, monitor partner performance, and contribute ideas to continuously improve service delivery—particularly for VIP and corporate accounts where attention to detail and discretion are essential.


Key Responsibilities

Guest Experience

  • Be the main point of contact for guests, responding to inquiries by email, phone, and live chat with professionalism and warmth.
  • Guide guests through the full journey—from pre-arrival checks to check-out—ensuring they feel supported at every stage.
  • Manage guest issues with empathy and efficiency, escalating only when necessary.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

  • Estabelecer diretrizes para que a arquitetura suporte o crescimento de volume e complexidade da companhia;
  • Desenvolver e automatizar pipelines de dados complexos, garantindo a entrega eficiente para modelos preditivos e análises avançadas;
  • Otimizar continuamente o desempenho dos fluxos de dados, reduzindo latência e custos operacionais de processamento;
  • Implementar ferramentas e práticas que permitam a escalabilidade da modelagem de dados voltada à decisão estratégica;
  • Gerenciar o ciclo de vida da aquisição de dados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para os stakeholders;
  • Garantir a qualidade, integridade e confiabilidade dos dados, estabelecendo processos de monitoramento e validação;
  • Atuar como ponte entre a tecnologia e as áreas de negócio, garantindo que as soluções de dados estejam alinhadas aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa.


Requisitos:


  • Formação em Tecnologia.
  • Sólida experiência em pipelines e Big Data (Python/Java/Scala);
  • Vivência em liderança de equipes e metodologias ágeis;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Perfil autônomo, analítico, comunicativo e orientado a resultados.

title: Data Platform Architect (Remote)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Data Platform Architect with 8+ years of experience to join our U.S. client. The role focuses on designing and building secure, scalable API and service integrations that connect SaaS products, data warehouses, and embedded analytics ecosystems.

The Data Platform Architect is responsible for defining, implementing, and evolving the end-to-end data architecture that powers our platform analytics, reporting, and data automation ecosystem. This role will design a scalable, automated multi-tenant data warehouse and pipeline architecture that integrates hundreds of tenant schemas from our SaaS platform into a centralized, governed, and cost-optimized analytics environment (AWS-based: Redshift, S3, Glue, Lake Formation, QuickSight).The ideal candidate combines deep data engineering expertise with systems-level architecture—balancing automation, performance, and cost while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and scalability for every customer.Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System that integrates booking, guest communications, and financial reporting, all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities


Architecture & Design

  • Architect a multi-tenant data platform capable of ingesting 500+ tenant schemas with automated onboarding/offboarding workflows
  • Design an end-to-end architecture that includes data lakes, warehouses, transformation pipelines, and semantic layers
  • Define data zone strategy (Raw Staging Serving), partitioning, and schema evolution patterns
  • Establish standards for data contracts, metadata cataloging, and lineage tracking across all tenants
  • Drive selection and configuration of core technologies (e.g., Redshift, Glue, S3, Lake Formation, dbt, Lambda, Airflow)
  • Collaborate with engineering and DevOps to ensure infrastructure as code (IaC) is applied to all data assets


Pipeline & Automation

  • Design metadata-driven ingestion and transformation pipelines supporting incremental updates, schema drift, and tenant isolation
  • Ensure pipelines are idempotent, self-healing, and fully integrated into CI/CD processes
  • Partner with the Data Pipeline Engineers to deliver automated data onboarding, testing, and quality validation


Performance & Cost Optimization

  • Define workload management, clustering, and distribution strategies in Redshift or equivalent MPP systems
  • Implement data lifecycle management policies to optimize storage and compute costs
  • Continuously evaluate query performance, caching, and concurrency scaling options


Governance & Security

  • Implement data governance frameworks to ensure privacy, PII compliance, and secure tenant isolation
  • Partner with InfoSec to align encryption (KMS multi-region keys), object lock, and access control policies with SOC/PCI/GDPR standards
  • Establish monitoring, alerting, and anomaly detection systems for data quality and operational stability


Collaboration & Leadership

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Analytics teams to ensure architecture aligns with business and product goals
  • Mentor engineers on modern data platform practices (dbt, ELT, IaC, observability)
  • Act as a technical authority and evangelist for data platform best practices within the organization


Required Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field; or equivalent professional experience
  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 8+ years in data engineering or data architecture, including at least 3 years architecting cloud-native data platforms
  • Proven success in building and maintaining large-scale data pipelines using AWS Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, or Airflow
  • Expertise in Redshift, Snowflake, or equivalent MPP databases, including workload management and query optimization
  • Proficiency with S3-based data lakes, Glue Data Catalog, and Lake Formation
  • Deep understanding of data modeling (Kimball/ELT) and multi-tenant system design
  • Experience defining and enforcing data governance frameworks (PII, access control, lineage)
  • Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/CloudFormation) and CI/CD for data assets
  • Strong SQL and Python skills; dbt experience preferred
  • Familiarity with embedded BI/analytics tools (QuickSight, GoodData) and semantic layer concepts


Desired Experience

  • Experience with schema-per-tenant architectures and automated tenant provisioning
  • Familiarity with Auth0 / SSO integration for analytics tools (e.g., QuickSight embedding)
  • Experience implementing observability platforms (e.g., Datadog, CloudWatch, Monte Carlo, Soda Core)
  • Exposure to data mesh or domain-oriented design principles
  • Prior experience in hospitality / property-management SaaS product ecosystems


Additional Information

  • When you know your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
We Are Sportingtech :


Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. Our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.


Who are You ?


You are relentlessly committed to delivering exceptional partner support, combining deep technical knowledge with sharp analytical skills to resolve issues efficiently and prevent them from recurring. You excel at interpreting data, logs, and system behavior to uncover root causes and provide clear, actionable insights to both partners and internal teams.


A confident and influential communicator, you build strong relationships with operators, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams. You thrive on translating complex technical details into understandable guidance, ensuring that partners always feel supported and informed.


Where you Fit In:


We are seeking a proactive and technically strong B2B Technical Support Specialist to join our growing team. In this role, you will leverage your deep understanding of the iGaming industry and your strong analytical mindset to troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve issues reported by our operators and internal stakeholders.


Working closely with the ITSM department — and reporting directly to the Technical Support Team Lead — you will be a key player in ensuring high-quality, timely support. Your ability to interpret logs, analyze platform behavior, communicate clearly, and escalate effectively will help maintain platform reliability and deliver an exceptional partner experience.


You will thrive in a fast-paced environment where attention to detail, technical curiosity, and a commitment to service excellence are essential. Your work will be pivotal in strengthening partner trust, improving operational stability, and supporting our mission to deliver a seamless and compliant gaming experience worldwide.


The impact you will have:


  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for B2B operators, platform partners, and integrators, ensuring their issues are resolved quickly, accurately, and with minimal business impact.
  • Perform in-depth technical troubleshooting across game integrations, wallet systems, API calls, transaction flows, and platform services — using logs, monitoring tools, and diagnostics to identify root causes.
  • Identify, flag, and track repetitive issues or recurring error patterns, escalating them with clear technical context to drive permanent fixes.
  • Ensure all partner interactions, escalations, and resolutions align with regulatory requirements, internal controls, and jurisdictional rules — maintaining strong compliance awareness at all times.
  • Coordinate cross-team escalations ensuring that complex issues are escalated and documented clearly and progressed efficiently.
  • Stay current with industry standards, emerging technologies, and best practices across iGaming, payments, and platform operations, recommending improvements to processes and tooling.
  • Champion adoption of shared support frameworks — authoring playbooks, SLA policies, runbooks, and knowledge-base articles to standardize excellence across the organization.


What we’re looking for:


  • Experience in B2B Technical Support within the Casino or iGaming sector.
  • Strong understanding of iGaming systems such as game aggregation, wallet services, RNG, bonus engines, player tracking, and jurisdictional compliance.
  • Experience working with logs, monitoring tools, and debugging complex integration issues.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple cases, partners, and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent English communication and presentation skills.
  • Hands-on experience with common support tooling (ex: Jira, Grafana, Kibana, etc.).


This role is remote and based in Brazil.


Sportingtech is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Coordenar a manutenção da frota automotiva pesada, média e leve, incluindo caminhões canavieiros, tratores, colhedoras, transbordos, veículos de apoio, implementos e equipamentos móveis.

  • Gerenciar equipes próprias e terceirizadas (mecânicos, eletricistas, lubrificadores, soldadores e apoio técnico).
  • Elaborar, monitorar e analisar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) como disponibilidade física, MTBF, MTTR, custo por km/hora, consumo de peças e combustíveis.
  • Controlar o orçamento da área, custos de manutenção, contratos de serviços e aquisição de peças e materiais.
  • Garantir o uso adequado do sistema de gestão de manutenção (CMMS), assegurando registros de ordens de serviço e histórico dos equipamentos.
  • Assegurar o cumprimento rigoroso das normas de Segurança do Trabalho (NRs), meio ambiente e procedimentos internos, promovendo a cultura de zero acidentes.
  • Analisar falhas recorrentes, conduzir análises de causa raiz e propor soluções definitivas e ações de redução de custos.
  • Apoiar tecnicamente projetos de renovação, padronização e melhoria da frota.
  • Atuar de forma integrada com as áreas agrícola, industrial, logística e suprimentos.
  • Coordenar manutenções durante paradas programadas e períodos críticos de operação.
  • Desenvolver e capacitar a equipe técnica, promovendo boas práticas de manutenção, segurança e melhoria contínua.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Sólidos conhecimentos em manutenção automotiva pesada, aplicada a caminhões canavieiros, tratores, transbordos e máquinas agrícolas.
  • Domínio de motores diesel, sistemas hidráulicos, pneumáticos, transmissões, diferenciais e sistemas elétricos/eletrônicos embarcados.

Brazil/Argentina (Remote)

Full Time

Technical Expertise:

  • Cloud Platform Proficiency: Solid experience (minimum 5 years) in architecting, deploying, and managing applications across leading cloud platforms, demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of cloud services including computing, database management, application development, and integration services. Familiarity with cloud-native services (Azure), containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), and serverless architectures is highly valued.
  • Embedded Systems and CI/CD: Experience with embedded devices, operating systems, and server-client architecture. Proficient in CI/CD and DevSecOps practices.
  • Architecture Design: Experience in Microservices and Event-Driven Architecture. Understanding architecture design principles and patterns. Experience with SQL Server, Web Services (SOAP/REST) and API development.


  • .NET Development Skills: Extensive hands-on experience in building scalable, high-performance applications using .NET technologies, with strong capabilities in C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, and Entity Framework. Knowledge of web technologies and frameworks, such as Blazor or ASP.NET MVC, is also crucial.
  • Integration with SAP and Salesforce: Demonstrated ability to integrate .NET applications with both SAP and Salesforce platforms, employing APIs and middleware solutions like SAP Process Orchestration or API to facilitate robust data exchange and streamline workflows across these systems.
  • Security and Compliance: Deep understanding of security practices related to cloud-hosted applications, including implementing secure authentication and authorization mechanisms (e.g., OAuth, OpenID Connect) and ensuring compliance with relevant industry security standards.
  • Scalability and High Availability: Proven expertise in designing applications that are highly scalable and resilient, leveraging cloud scalability features such as load balancing, auto-scaling, and caching services to ensure optimal performance and availability.
  • Agile Development Practices: Strong background in Agile methodologies, adept at managing product backlogs, user stories, sprint planning, and releases, particularly within a cloud-hosted application development environment.
  • Strategic Problem Solving and Analytical Thinking: Ability to address complex technical and integration challenges with a strategic mindset, utilizing analytical and data-driven decision-making to optimize the application's performance and capabilities.


Specialized Skills:

  • Prototyping: Ability to engage in rapid prototype development using iterative techniques.
  • Vendor and Partner Engagement: Direct experience managing relationships with outsourcing and consulting partners.
  • Cloud Architecture Design: Deep understanding of cloud solutions and architectures, enabling scalable, flexible, and resilient digital infrastructures that support rapid innovation and development.


Soft Skills and Others:

  • Agile Collaboration: Demonstrated experience in effectively working with Agile and Product teams, including involvement with epics, user stories, sprints, and backlog management. The ability to collaborate closely with product owners, engineers, and scrum master’s to foster a productive and agile environment.
  • Leadership in Communication and Reporting: Skilled in leading communication efforts and reporting, adept at preparing and presenting comprehensive updates and reports to senior leaders and stakeholders. Ability to succinctly highlight key metrics, progress, and insights, ensuring transparency and alignment at all levels of the organization.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Background in coordinating hardware & software development teams and business owners, with the ability to influence SMEs directly.

title: Finance Senior Analyst
description:
About MGI

In April 2024, MGI Tech opened a Customer Experience Center in Brazil to contribute to the advancement of genomics in Latin America. The goal is to provide a facility for clinical and research laboratories, hospitals, and universities to enhance learning and experience with genetic sequencing technology, applied in precision medicine, oncology, Agri genomics (the application of genomics in agriculture), and metagenomics (the study of environmental microbial communities), among other segments. MGI Brazil is committed to enabling effective and affordable healthcare solutions for all. Based on its proprietary technology, MGI produces sequencing devices, equipment, consumables, and reagents to support life science research, medicine, and healthcare. MGI is recognized globally as an innovator and for conducting international collaborative projects with leading research institutions for the betterment of mankind and the world in which we live. MGI values its employees, as we believe they are the driving force behind our success and commercial expansion globally.

POSITION PROFILE

MGI is seeking an in-country finance professional to play an important role in the expansion of business operations in Brazil. This position will be responsible for ensuring accurate and timely financials for MGI-Brazil as well as managing the contract accounting firm for Brazil operations and liaison with the commercial team in Brazil. In order to achieve success in this role the position requires the ability to collaborate effectively across all functions and levels, as well as across international boundaries, with finance teams in the US and Shenzhen, China.

Reporting to the US Finance Director, the position is based in São Paulo, Brazil.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Financial Operation:

  • Oversee day-to-day accounting operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, and general ledger activities.
  • Support customer invoicing and sales tax calculation.
  • Ensure timely and accurate processing of financial transactions.
  • Maintain and improve internal controls and financial procedures.
  • Support financial processes and IT system improvements (e.g., CRM, Oracle ERP, Concur, internally designed Shared Service Platform)


Month-end Closing and Reporting:

  • Responsible for over-seeing the contract accounting team in Brazil.
  • Prepare Month-end closing and ensure accurate and timely Finance Statements are submitted to HQ Reporting team.
  • Arrange stock take and fixed assets take procedures.


Tax Compliance and annual audit support:

  • Ensure compliance with local and international accounting standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Work with tax consultants to prepare and file tax returns, ensuring compliance with local tax regulations.
  • Support group annual audit procedures (i.e. audit confirmations and PBC list)


Cash Management:

  • Monitor and manage the company's cash flow, ensuring sufficient liquidity for operations.
  • Own the cash management function and liaison with treasury administrator in US.


Budgeting and Forecasting:

  • Participate in the annual budgeting process for MGI Brazil and Actual v Budget analysis.
  • Monitor financial performance against budgets and forecasts, identifying variances and recommending corrective actions.


Commercial Team Support:

  • Build relationships with and support the Brazil Commercial team.
  • Identify opportunities for cost reduction and efficiency improvements.


QUALIFICATIONS

  • At least 5 years of relevant accounting experience in a fast-paced, fluid, results-oriented, hands-on environment, including with teams that are geographically dispersed across international boundaries.
  • Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial regulations, and reporting standards.
  • Experience with ERP and Financial IT systems (e.g., CRM, Oracle ERP, Concur, etc.)
  • BS/BA degree in Accounting/Finance/Business. CPA a plus.
  • Biotechnology/Medical Devices/Pharmaceutical industry experience and multinational experience; experience with import tax a plus.
  • Proven experience in instrument sales or related industry is a plus.
  • Knowledge of Portuguese and English is required. Chinese language a plus.
  • Must have strong excel skills.

BEHAVIORS, SKILLS, AND KNOWLEDGE

  • Team-oriented with outstanding integrity, accuracy, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to proactively identify and solve problems.
  • Exhibits the highest degree of integrity and ethics, with the ability to work independently and with minimal supervision.
  • Strong team player willing to be flexible and to tackle a variety of tasks and responsibilities.
  • Ability to navigate and be successful in a highly matrixed, fast-paced environment.
  • Results-oriented with excellent analytic, communication, and collaboration skills
  • Ability to operate under different business models and complex business structures.

title: Analista de Controladoria de Fundos
description:
Sobre a Prisma:

A Prisma Capital é uma empresa de investimentos alternativos fundada em 2017 que oferece soluções criativas para problemas complexos que exigem capital de longo prazo. A equipe da Prisma Capital é experiente, multidisciplinar e com um histórico de mais de R$ 12bi implantados com retornos atrativos. A Prisma tem sede em São Paulo, 66 funcionários e possui em torno de R$ 22bi sob gestão.


A Prisma tem um mandato de investimento altamente flexível que inclui um espectro completo de transações estruturadas, independentemente do tamanho, classe de ativo ou setor. A Prisma acredita que essa abordagem multiestratégia é fundamental para a geração de retornos não correlacionados com os ciclos macroeconômicos brasileiros.


Overview da Posição:

Estamos em busca de um Analista de Controladoria com boa comunicação, senso crítico, com forte atenção aos detalhes e comprometido com a alta qualidade das entregas. O profissional será responsável por criar, implementar e acompanhar controles rigorosos para os ativos e passivos de toda a estrutura de fundos onshore e offshore da nossa gestora, além de coordenar o processo de auditoria e revisar as demonstrações financeiras e contábeis dos fundos.


Responsabilidade:

  • Controle das carteiras (Divulgação de cotas, reconciliação de informações divulgadas pelo administrador, validação de cálculos);
  • Suporte a áreas internas (Relatórios para investidores, fornecimento de informações regulatórias);
  • Suporte ao processo de auditoria dos fundos e revisão de demonstrações financeiras;
  • Controle de cotistas (Reconciliação das posições, análise de distribuições, chamadas de capital etc.);
  • Análise da rentabilidade dos fundos (Variações nos valores dos ativos e passivos, análise dos impactos mais relevantes);
  • Marcação a mercado de diversos tipos de ativos, líquidos e ilíquidos (Revisão e validação da precificação dos ativos em carteira, comparações com modelagens gerenciais);
  • Coordenação do processo de avaliação de ativos de Private Equity;


Desejável:

  • Coordenação das atividades de US tax compliance e reports de FATCA/CRS com prestadores;
  • Interface com administrador de fundos offshore sediados em Cayman, Canadá e USA, instruindo e revisando a contabilidade, demonstrações financeiras e notas explicativas.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Superior completo em Ciências Exatas, Econômicas, Contábeis, Administração e Engenharias;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Excel avançado;
  • Experiência anterior em asset management ou similar;
  • Diferencial: experiência em fundos offshore com investidores estrangeiros.

title: Engenheiro Pleno de AI & LLM
description:
A Beegol  é uma empresa de tecnologia especializada em diagnóstico inteligente de redes. Processamos grandes volumes de dados e aplicamos técnicas avançadas de machine learning para detectar e resolver problemas com rapidez e precisão.

Quer dar o próximo passo na carreira trabalhando todos os dias com modelos de linguagem de ponta  em produção? Vem com a gente !


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER

  • Atuar no treinamento, fine-tuning e avaliação  de Large Language Models (LLMs) voltados a produtos em produção.
  • Projetar, construir e manter pipelines de dados  (coleta, limpeza, transformação e versionamento) com foco em qualidade e reprodutibilidade.
  • Colaborar na definição da arquitetura  de agentes de IA e na integração desses componentes aos nossos produtos e APIs.
  • Contribuir ativamente em code reviews , definição de boas práticas e melhoria contínua dos nossos sistemas de ML em produção.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com outros engenheiros(as) e times de produto, ajudando a transformar requisitos de negócio em soluções baseadas em LLMs.


REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS

  • Experiência sólida com Python e SQL :
  • Desenvolvimento de scripts, ETLs e integrações.
  • Consultas otimizadas e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Conhecimento prático em machine learning em produção , incluindo experiência com LLMs  (uso de APIs, fine-tuning, prompt engineering ou avaliação de modelos).
  • Experiência comprovada em AWS , incluindo pelo menos alguns destes serviços:
  • API Gateway, Lambda, ECS, Fargate ou equivalentes de orquestração/conteneirização.
  • Vivência com ambientes de produção : monitoramento básico, logs, versionamento de modelos ou pipelines, boas práticas de engenharia.
  • Inglês intermediário : capaz de ler documentação técnica e escrever mensagens/PRs em inglês, quando necessário.
  • Formação completa  em Ciência/Engenharia da Computação, Data Science, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Ter alguns anos de experiência  (ou equivalente em projetos intensivos) trabalhando com dados, ML ou desenvolvimento de software em ambiente profissional.


DIFERENCIAIS

  • Ter colocado em produção  soluções envolvendo LLMs e/ou agentes de IA (projetos profissionais ou autorais bem estruturados).
  • Experiência com infraestrutura como código  (por exemplo, Terraform).
  • Familiaridade com MLOps  (tracking de experimentos, versionamento de modelos/datasets, CI/CD para ML).
  • Participação ativa em code reviews , definição de padrões de código e documentação técnica.
  • Perfil mão na massa, com autonomia , responsabilidade sobre entregas e grande vontade de aprender novas tecnologias.


COMO TRABALHAMOS

  • Modelo híbrido  para São Paulo (capital) ou remoto (demais localidades).
  • Regime PJ , com atuação em tempo mínimo de 40 horas semanais .
  • Horário flexível , com foco em resultados , mas é importante ter disponibilidade para participar de reuniões de alinhamento  e colaboração com o time.
  • Ambiente colaborativo, com cultura forte de mentoria , trocas técnicas frequentes e aprendizado contínuo .


QUER FAZER PARTE?

Envie seu currículo, portfólio (GitHub, artigos, projetos, etc.) e pretensão financeira para: c  com o assunto: “Engenheiro(a) de AI & LLM – (Seu Nome)”

Na Beegol, você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar com especialistas, criar soluções de IA que impactam milhões de usuários de redes e crescer junto com a nossa equipe. Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você!

title: Especialista de Suprimentos com foco em Tecnologia da Informação
description:
Especialista de Suprimentos com foco em Tecnologia da Informação

Código da Vaga:


Atuação 100% presencial em Curitiba / PR


Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista de Suprimentos com foco em Tecnologia da Informação , para atuar de forma estratégica na gestão de contratações de software, serviços de TI e soluções tecnológicas , garantindo eficiência, compliance, mitigação de riscos e geração de valor ao negócio.

O profissional será responsável por conduzir processos complexos de sourcing, negociação e gestão contratual, atuando como parceiro das áreas técnicas, jurídica e financeira.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Conduzir processos de contratação de software, licenças, SaaS, cloud, outsourcing, fábricas de software, AMS, infraestrutura, cybersecurity e serviços especializados de TI ;
  • Estruturar e liderar RFI, RFP e RFQ , desde a definição de estratégia até a recomendação final;
  • Atuar na equalização técnica e comercial das propostas, assegurando comparabilidade e aderência ao escopo;
  • Negociar condições comerciais, SLAs, modelos de precificação, reajustes, cláusulas contratuais e mitigação de riscos;
  • Elaborar, revisar e gerir contratos de TI , em conjunto com a área jurídica, garantindo conformidade regulatória e aderência às políticas internas;
  • Atuar na gestão do ciclo de vida contratual (vigência, aditivos, renovações, indicadores e penalidades);
  • Desenvolver e gerir relacionamento estratégico com fornecedores , incluindo avaliação de performance e riscos;
  • Utilizar ferramentas de procurement e ERP (ex.: SAP, Coupa, Ariba ou similares);
  • Apoiar iniciativas de redução de custos, TCO, savings, compliance e melhoria contínua ;
  • Garantir aderência às boas práticas de governança, ética e integridade nos processos de contratação.


Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Administração, Engenharia, Economia, ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida e comprovada em suprimentos com foco em TI , incluindo contratações de software e serviços tecnológicos;
  • Forte atuação em negociação e gestão de contratos complexos ;
  • Conhecimento em modelos de licenciamento (SaaS, on-premise, subscription, pay-per-use) e serviços de TI;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de procurement/ERP ;
  • Capacidade analítica para leitura de propostas técnicas e comerciais;
  • Conhecimento de práticas de Strategic Sourcing, TCO, SLA, KPI e gestão de riscos ;
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de relacionamento com áreas técnicas e executivas.
  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado.


Diferenciais:

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Supply Chain, Compras, Gestão de Contratos ou Tecnologia;
  • Experiência em ambientes regulados ou de grande porte;
  • Atuação prévia com contratos de tecnologia em empresas de energia, indústria ou serviços ;

title: Analytics Architect – Azure Databricks / Fabric
description:
Analytics Architect – Azure Databricks / Microsoft Fabric


Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture, design and implementation of advanced analytics solutions using Azure Databricks and Microsoft Fabric .
  • Partner closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional IT teams to translate requirements into scalable analytics platforms.
  • Own the end-to-end delivery of data solutions, ensuring adherence to architectural standards, security, governance and best practices.
  • Design, build and optimize data ingestion pipelines and ETL/ELT frameworks using Azure Databricks, PySpark and Azure Data Factory .
  • Integrate Databricks with Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Azure Synapse, Microsoft Fabric and on-premise systems.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to data engineering teams, promoting continuous improvement and innovation.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of architecture, data flows and operational processes.
  • Enforce best practices around code quality, performance optimization, scalability and data security.
  • Stay current with Databricks and Azure analytics advancements to continuously evolve the platform.


Essential Skills

  • Extensive hands-on experience with Azure Databricks , including cluster management, notebooks and Delta Lake .
  • Strong proficiency in PySpark , Spark and big data technologies (Hadoop ecosystem).
  • In-depth knowledge of Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory , Power BI, SSRS, SSAS and SKU transitions (PSKU to F SKU).
  • Expertise in building data lakes, data warehouses and large-scale ETL/ELT pipelines.
  • Advanced SQL skills with familiarity in NoSQL databases.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines , Git and modern DevOps practices.
  • Solid understanding of cloud security and governance principles.


Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to business stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with a proactive approach to risk mitigation.
  • Proven leadership and mentoring capabilities.


Nice to Have

  • Advanced experience with Power BI for reporting and analytics.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric for analytics and integration workloads.
  • Experience with Spark Streaming for real-time data processing.
  • Familiarity with Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates and Infrastructure as Code practices.


Experience Requirements

  • 12+ years of experience building data ingestion and transformation pipelines using Databricks, Synapse Notebooks and Azure Data Factory .
  • Hands-on expertise with Delta Tables, Delta Lake and ADLS Gen2 .
  • Experience using Auto Loader and Delta Live Tables for scalable data ingestion.
  • Proven ability to build and optimize query layers using Databricks SQL .
  • Demonstrated integration of Databricks with Azure Synapse, ADLS Gen2 and Power BI for end-to-end analytics solutions.
  • Prior experience designing, optimizing and deploying Power BI dashboards and reports .
  • Strong exposure to modern CI/CD frameworks within Databricks and cloud-native environments.

Qual localidade?

Unidade Mandu (Guaíra/SP).


O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.


Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.


Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Desenvolvedor sênior
description:
DESENVOLVEDOR SÊNIOR


Sobre a vaga

Você é um apaixonado por negócios e Tecnologia e está em busca de novos desafios? Então, a *** é o seu lugar! Estamos crescendo cada dia mais e buscando pessoas com espírito de liderança, criativas e atentas à inovação para fazer parte do nosso time. Se você está pronto para fazer parte de um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo e quer transformar o mercado financeiro, confira os requisitos para a vaga de Desenvolvedor Sênior .


Sobre a Empresa

Somos um Hub de novos modelos de negócios que constrói produtos financeiros e bancários aliados à inovação. Nossas soluções proprietárias e de alta infraestrutura tecnológica atendem a necessidade de cada parceiro de maneira simples, eficiente e segura.

Nossa marca está no centro da revolução financeira, afinal, somos referência em Credit as a Service e o BAAS (Banking As a Service) número 1 do Brasil, com o propósito de transformar o mercado financeiro e construir, junto com os nossos parceiros, o Banco do Futuro.


Principais atividades (Tarefas e atribuições):

• Projetar, desenvolver e manter APIs e serviços back-end utilizando C# e .NET;

• Participar da definição de arquitetura e escolha de soluções técnicas;

• Garantir a qualidade do código com testes automatizados, code reviews e boas práticas de engenharia;

• Identificar e resolver gargalos de performance e problemas técnicos complexos;

• Colaborar com equipes de front-end, produto e infraestrutura.


Do que você precisa (Requisitos e Qualificações):

• Experiência avançada com C# e .NET (Framework e/ou .NET Core);

• Domínio de bancos de dados relacionais (ex: SQL Server, PostgreSQL);

• Experiência com desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful e arquitetura de microsserviços;

• Familiaridade com ferramentas de versionamento (Git) e integração contínua;

• Conhecimento em ambientes de nuvem (preferencialmente AWS);

• Capacidade de trabalhar com autonomia, proatividade e foco em resultados.


Diferenciais:

• Conhecimento ou vivência em Scrum;

• Experiência no setor financeiro.


Informações adicionais:

• Modelo remoto;

• Jornada de 2ª a 6ª.


O que oferecemos:

• Salário compatível com o mercado;

• VR Flex no valor de R$45,00;

• Convênio Médico Unimed;

• Convênio Odontológico MetLife;

• Convênio com a FIAP (descontos para cursos de graduação, Pós e MBA em tecnologia);

• Escola (cursos gratuitos nas áreas de comunicação, financeira, tecnologia e outras);

• Programa Construindo o Futuro;

• Bonificações anuais;

  • Experiência prévia de estágio na área financeira.

title: Application Support- Dynatrace (Realocation to Portugal)

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What will you be doing:

  • Providing application support and monitoring using Dynatrace;
  • Troubleshooting and resolving issues in Linux-based environments;
  • Ensuring observability and performance optimization of applications;
  • Collaborating with development and infrastructure teams to enhance system reliability;
  • Writing and executing SQL queries for data analysis and issue resolution;
  • Establishing best practices for application performance and monitoring;



What are we looking for?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or similar;
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in Application Support, with at least 3 years of Dynatrace experience;
  • Experience with Linux environments;
  • SQL knowledge (other database experience is also considered);
  • Experience in Observability/Monitoring tools (Dynatrace preferred);
  • Java knowledge is a plus;
  • Minimum B2 level in English (written and spoken), and Portuguese ;
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills;
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and collaborate with cross-functional teams;
  • Hybrid work model: available to work in Porto or Lisbon;
  • Mandatory availability to relocate (from Brazil to Portuga l).



What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid setting based in Lisbon or Porto.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with 30 years of experience, is seeking a Salesforce OEM Application Developer to support a US-based customer. This position collaborates with development teams in the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil, focusing on designing, developing, and maintaining a managed Salesforce OEM application.


This role is ideal for someone with deep Salesforce development expertise, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly in English.


About the Role:


As a Salesforce OEM Application Developer, you will work closely with product managers, clients, and internal teams to gather and refine technical requirements, translate business needs into robust application features, and maintain a secure, scalable Salesforce OEM solution. You will develop advanced functionality combining code and configuration, manage integrations and data migrations, troubleshoot application-level issues, and support packaging, versioning, and upgrades of the managed application.


Responsibilities:


  • Design, develop, and maintain a managed Salesforce OEM application using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and declarative tools.
  • Build advanced Salesforce functionality, including complex Flows, triggers, asynchronous processing, and Community/Experience Cloud implementations .
  • Architect scalable and secure solutions aligned with Salesforce OEM/ISV best practices , including multi-tenant considerations and upgrade-safe design.
  • Develop and maintain custom data models, integrations, and automation , ensuring performance, governor-limit compliance, and maintainability.
  • Manage data migration and transformation processes using Apex, ETL tools, and Salesforce APIs.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve application-level issues including Apex logic, automation conflicts, and deployment errors.
  • Build test classes with strong code coverage and participate in CI/CD and release management activities.
  • Produce and maintain technical documentation , including architecture workbooks, developer/admin guides, testing strategies, and deployment protocols.
  • Collaborate with Salesforce Administrators and customer technical teams to ensure correct configuration and extension of the OEM application.


Required Experience:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Systems Analysis, Computer Engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong hands-on Salesforce development experience , including Apex, SOQL/SOSL, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Proven experience blending programmatic development and declarative configuration for scalable Salesforce solutions.
  • Experience designing and implementing advanced Flows, triggers, and automation based on business rules.
  • Deep understanding of Salesforce platform capabilities, security, permissions, sharing models, and performance optimization .
  • Experience collaborating with stakeholders to design sophisticated user experiences across screens, records, and automation processes.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, version control, and modern release practices .
  • Salesforce certifications: Platform Developer I/II, Administrator or Advanced Administrator (Platform App Builder preferred).
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills in English.
  • Familiarity with C# and the .NET ecosystem for backend services or integrations.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with AI-assisted development workflows for code generation, testing, or documentation.
  • Prior experience building or supporting OEM/ISV applications , including managed packages, AppExchange distribution, or Salesforce Security Review preparation.
  • BS/MS in Systems Analysis and Development, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent.

title: Engenheiro de dados SR
description:
A Stone:

Como é ser um Egenheiro de Dados:

O Engenheiro de Dados será responsável por construir, implantar e otimizar pipelines de dados confiáveis e escaláveis, garantindo que os dados brutos sejam transformados em informações úteis e acessíveis para a tomada de decisões estratégicas e segmentação de jornadas no contexto de CRM. O profissional trabalhará em estreita colaboração com analistas de negócios e equipes de TI para suportar diversas iniciativas orientadas por dados.


As suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Criar e gerenciar pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT): Desenvolver fluxos automatizados e confiáveis para extrair, transformar e carregar dados de diversas fontes, utilizando ferramentas de orquestração.
  • Assegurar a qualidade dos dados: Implementar processos para monitorar a qualidade e a integridade dos dados, identificando e corrigindo falhas na estrutura para evitar comprometimento das análises e jornadas.
  • Otimizar performance: Monitorar o desempenho dos sistemas de dados e implementar melhorias para garantir o processamento rápido e eficiente de consultas e análises.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência em SQL (Procedures, DML, DDL, Pipelines) & Python.
  • Plataformas de Nuvem: Experiência com serviços de nuvem (GCP, Amplitude, Salesforce Marketing Cloud) para armazenamento e processamento de dados.
  • Ferramentas de orquestração: Airflow e Cloud Functions.
  • Engenharia de Software: Conhecimento em boas práticas de codificação, versionamento (Git) e testes.
  • Capacidade de Resolução de Problemas e Pensamento Crítico: Habilidade analítica para identificar gargalos, depurar sistemas complexos e encontrar soluções eficazes de forma proativa.
  • Comunicação Eficaz: Clareza para explicar conceitos técnicos complexos para públicos não técnicos (como times de negócios e gestão), e vice-versa, garantindo o alinhamento de expectativas e resultados.
  • Trabalho em Equipe e Colaboração: Atuar de forma integrada com engenheiros de dados, analistas e outras equipes, contribuindo para um ambiente produtivo e sinérgico.
  • Orientação para Resultados: Foco em entregar soluções de dados que gerem valor real para o negócio e impulsionam a tomada de decisões.


Jornada de Trabalho:

  • CLT: 8 horas diárias + 1h de intervalo | Escala: 5x2 Segunda à sexta - de 08h às 17h ou de 09h às 18h.


Modelo/Local de trabalho:

  • Remoto


Etapas do Processo Seletivo

✍Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!

Entrevistas com o time de People: Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.

Case/ Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.

✅Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.


Nossa Cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

title: Financial Controller
description:
Join a team that values you. At StaffRight, we connect talented professionals with global opportunities—and we’re growing fast! With competitive pay, health insurance, paid time off (including national holidays), and a supportive HR team always in your corner, you’ll love building your career with us.


The Controller is a hands-on, strategic finance leader responsible for overseeing all accounting operations across the company. This role ensures accurate financial reporting, strong internal controls, and scalable processes to support a growing, multi-brand food business.


The Controller partners closely with leadership to provide financial insights, manage cash flow, and support operational decision-making in a fast-moving CPG environment. This role is ideal for someone who is detail-oriented, highly organized, and comfortable operating at both the transactional and strategic levels.


This role is open to all candidates in the Philippines and all over Latin America.


What You’ll Be Doing:


Financial Accounting & Reporting

  • Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close process for all entities
  • Prepare and review timely and accurate financial statements including P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow
  • Ensure proper revenue recognition, inventory accounting, COGS, and accruals
  • Maintain and enforce consistent accounting policies and procedures
  • Manage the chart of accounts and general ledger structure to support brand-level and customer-level analysis


Inventory, Costing & Manufacturing Finance

  • Oversee inventory accounting for raw materials, work-in-process, and finished goods
  • Ensure accurate standard costing and variance analysis across materials, labor, and overhead
  • Partner with Operations to reconcile production, yields, and inventory movements
  • Drive accuracy and functionality of ERP systems, including Katana
  • Monitor and analyze margins by SKU, customer, and sales channel


Cash Flow, AP/AR & Controls

  • Manage cash flow forecasting and short- and medium-term liquidity planning
  • Oversee accounts payable and accounts receivable processes
  • Improve working capital efficiency including inventory turns, DSO, and DPO
  • Implement and maintain strong internal controls and approval workflows
  • Manage vendor payments, ACH and check processes, and banking relationships


Systems, Process & Scale

  • Own and optimize accounting systems and integrations including QuickBooks, ERP (Katana), and bill-pay tools
  • Improve automation, documentation, and repeatable finance processes
  • Prepare the finance function for audit readiness and future growth
  • Partner on system upgrades, implementations, and reporting enhancements


Compliance & External Relationships

  • Ensure compliance with GAAP and applicable tax and regulatory requirements
  • Coordinate with external CPA firms on tax filings, reviews, and audits
  • Support state and federal reporting requirements as applicable
  • Assist with insurance, sales tax, and other compliance areas


Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Manage and develop accounting staff or external resources as the business grows
  • Partner with Sales, Operations, and Supply Chain to provide financial insights
  • Deliver clear financial analysis to support pricing, promotions, and customer strategy
  • Act as a trusted financial thought partner to the CEO and leadership team


What We’re Looking For:


  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • CPA preferred but not required
  • 7+ years of progressive accounting or finance experience
  • Experience in CPG, food and beverage, manufacturing, or inventory-heavy businesses strongly preferred
  • Strong understanding of inventory accounting, costing, and margin analysis
  • Hands-on experience with QuickBooks and ERP systems
  • Katana experience is a strong plus
  • Proven ability to build and scale processes in a growing or entrepreneurial environment
  • Available to work in US time zones (Graveyard shift in the Philippines)
  • Available to start within 2 weeks from job offer


Technical Requirements:

  • Comfortable in using time-trackers (e.g. Time Doctor)
  • Own laptop/desktop, noise-cancelling headphones, and webcam
  • Reliable internet connection (at least 50 Mbps)
  • Available backup equipment in cases of power and internet outages
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and Google Workspace


Why You’ll Love Working Here:

Competitive Compensation

We offer a monthly salary based on your experience and qualifications. This is a full-time role requiring a 40-hour work week, and we make sure your expertise is valued and your contributions are fairly rewarded.


✈️ Paid Time Off and Sick Leave:

We believe in work-life balance. Enjoy generous paid time off and sick leave policies, allowing you to recharge, travel, or rest when needed—all while knowing your role is secure.

title: Senior Elixir Developer
description:
Who We Are Seeking:


We’re looking for a talented and experienced Elixir Backend Developer to join our international team and help design, build, and harden our agentic contracts execution layer —the platform where autonomous/agent-driven workflows orchestrate and execute contractual logic reliably, at scale. This role presents an excellent opportunity for those looking to work in a dynamic environment and be part of a high-performing international team, offering ample opportunities for growth and development in technical and interpersonal skills. You’ll work on resilient OTP services, job orchestration, stateful workflows, and observability to ensure correctness, auditability, and performance. We seek an energetic, driven, and articulate team player who is truly passionate about their work


Your Role and Responsibilities:  

  • Design and implement Elixir/OTP services (GenServer, Supervision trees, Registries) that power contract execution and agentic workflows.
  • Own the lifecycle of long-running, event-driven workflows (timers, scheduling, compensations/Saga patterns, exactly-once/at-least-once semantics).
  • Develop secure APIs and integrations, rate limiting, and request budgets for agent calls.
  • Optimize performance (ETS, streams, batching, backpressure) and observability (tracing, metrics, structured logs).
  • Collaborate with Product and AI/Agent teams to translate requirements into deterministic, testable contract execution flows.
  • Write high-quality tests, migrations, and production-grade documentation.


Tech You’ll Use:

  • Elixir /OTP (GenServer, Supervisors, Applications), Phoenix (APIs), Ecto (PostgreSQL), Oban, OpenTelemetry/PromEx
  • Message brokers & streams: Kafka or RabbitMQ
  • Container & cloud: Docker , Kubernetes , AWS/GCP/Azure
  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions (or similar), feature flags, migrations & rollout strategies


Essential Qualifications:  

  • 3+ years building production Elixir/OTP services (or 5+ years BE + 1–2 years Elixir with strong OTP fundamentals).
  • Deep understanding of concurrency, supervision strategies, and fault tolerance on the BEAM.
  • Solid experience with Ecto/MySQL , schema design, transactions, and migrations.
  • Practical knowledge of job orchestration (Oban or equivalent), idempotency, retries, and backpressure.
  • Proven track record in building and maintaining event-driven or workflow systems with strong correctness guarantees.
  • Comfortable with containerized deployments and CI/CD; you ship and you own.
  • Strong written and spoken English (daily collaboration in English).


Who We Are:

DevGrid is a top-tier software consulting company based in the UK, with a development hub in Brazil and operations spanning Europe and the US. We believe that world-class software can only be created by a motivated and enthusiastic team in an environment that fosters creativity and free thinking. Established in 2015, we aim to drive innovation and digital transformation by combining our robust business culture and exceptional engineers with forward-thinking business insights.

  • Open and flexible time-off policy;
  • Supportive and collaborative work environment;
  • Equipment program;
  • Paid days off per year + holidays (variable) + recess days;

title: PMO Analyst – Telecommunications
description:
Job Summary:

ZTE Brazil is looking for a detail-oriented and proactive PMO Analyst to support project governance, performance monitoring, and process standardization across telecom deployment and operations projects. This role will interface with clients such as TIM, Claro, and Vivo, ensuring compliance with internal methodologies and contractual obligations.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Support the structuring and maintenance of the project portfolio aligned with the company’s strategic goals.
  • Monitor execution of project schedules, scope, cost, and risk, especially for network deployment projects (RAN, IP, DWDM, Microwave, etc).
  • Develop executive dashboards and performance reports (KPIs) for internal management and external clients.
  • Standardize and control technical project documentation (MoP, LLD, HLD, acceptance packages), ensuring proper version control and traceability.
  • Participate in project follow-up meetings with clients and internal stakeholders (engineering, logistics, finance, and operations).
  • Assist in contract management and milestone tracking to ensure accurate billing and deliverable compliance.
  • Promote best practices and methodologies in project management (PMBOK, PMI, Agile, PRINCE2 as applicable).
  • Contribute to lessons learned documentation and support the continuous improvement of project processes.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Telecommunications, IT or related fields.
  • Experience in a PMO or project coordination role, preferably within telecom or tech companies.
  • Strong understanding of project management tools, schedule control, and executive reporting.
  • Previous experience working in multicultural environments or with Chinese organizations is a plus.
  • Advanced English is mandatory; Mandarin or Spanish is a differential.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Project, advanced Excel, Power BI, Jira/Confluence.
  • Desirable certifications: PMP, CAPM, PRINCE2 Foundation, or Scrum Master.


Behavioral Competencies:

  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and methodical.
  • Strong interpersonal communication and collaborative mindset.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage competing priorities.
  • Initiative and ownership over assigned responsibilities.


Differentials:

  • Hands-on experience with field operations, network rollout or swap projects.
  • Familiarity with Anatel regulations and telecom compliance frameworks.
  • Prior knowledge of telecom vendors ecosystem and operational model in Brazil.
  • MBA or equivalent degree in Project Management.

title: Consultor em Finanças e Performance Empresarial
description:
Descrição da Empresa: UP Strategy Consultoria de Estrategia e Gestão

Descrição do Cargo: Estamos em busca de um Consultor de Finanças e Performance Empresarial para integrar nossa equipe na UP Strategy Consultoria de Gestão e Estratégia. Este cargo envolve a estruturação de processos financeiros, do básico ao avançado, análise de desempenho financeiro empresarial, desenvolvimento de planos financeiros estratégicos e planejamento e apoio à tomada de decisões de investimentos (Estudos de viabilidade e Business Plan). O profissional atuará em formato híbrido, com parte do trabalho sendo realizada remotamente, parte no escritório em São Paulo e/ou em escritórios de clientes pelo Brasil, portanto, disponibilidade para viagens pontuais é necessária. Trata-se de um cargo por contrato PJ.

Qualificações:

  • O candidato ideal deverá demonstrar profunda experiência em planejamento e gestão financeira, com foco no desenvolvimento de estratégias para maximizar recursos. É essencial ter um domínio completo sobre a estruturação financeira, incluindo a criação de modelos financeiros integrados (DRE, Balanço e Fluxo de Caixa), a elaboração de DRE gerencial e o desenvolvimento de planos de contas e centros de custo. A habilidade para mapear e otimizar processos financeiros, bem como para definir e acompanhar KPIs financeiros e operacionais, é fundamental.
  • No que tange à execução e controle financeiro, esperamos proficiência na estruturação de contas a receber e a pagar, e na elaboração e projeção de fluxo de caixa (operacional e projetado para 12 meses). O profissional deve ser capaz de realizar análises aprofundadas, como o estudo do ciclo de caixa, capital de giro e o cálculo do cash conversion cycle, contribuindo para decisões financeiras assertivas de curto e longo prazo.
  • Em relação à inteligência financeira e análise estratégica, são exigidas habilidades analíticas avançadas para desenvolver relatórios detalhados e auxiliar na execução de estratégias empresariais. Isso inclui a capacidade de realizar análises de rentabilidade multidimensional, modelagem de EBITDA e margem de contribuição, análise de break-even e alavancagem operacional. A experiência na criação de dashboards executivos, utilizando ferramentas como Power BI ou Excel, será um diferencial importante.
  • Para o planejamento estratégico financeiro, o consultor deverá ser capaz de conduzir o processo de orçamento anual (base real ou OBZ), desenvolver projeções financeiras de 3 a 5 anos e modelar cenários (otimista, base e pessimista). A experiência com modelos de receita recorrente (MRR, ARR, Churn, LTV) e o planejamento estratégico do capital de giro são competências cruciais para a função.

Formação:

  • Administração, Economia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas será considerada um diferencial, bem como a certificação em áreas financeiras ou de investimentos.

title: ESPECIALISTA EM OPERAÇÃO E EFICIÊNCIA - ENERGIA
description:
Quer fazer parte de um time que impulsiona o progresso por meio da energia?


Na Light, buscamos alguém que terá como missão ser responsável por liderar os processos processos analíticos estratégicos voltados à operação de sistemas elétricos de Alta, Média e Baixa Tensão (AT, MT e BT), operações de campo, qualidade regulatória, eficiência operacional e ciência de dados. Deverá estar apto a analisar e aplicar modelos operacionais, estudos de capacidade, dimensionamento e de desempenho operacional utilizando modelos matemáticos/estatísticos/econométricos, para indicar soluções numéricas para problemas de projeção e análise de impactos operacionais e regulatórios. Deverá focar sua atuação na construção de análises de impacto operacional, visando mensurar, modelar e projetar cenários quantitativos e qualitativos, de modo a avaliar os efeitos sobre indicadores estratégicos e operacionais da organização.



Seus principais desafios serão:


  • Pensar estrategicamente a operação (fora da caixa);
  • Criar novos modelos matemáticos/estatísticos para análise de dados e projeções diversas (dimensionamento, demandas, despacho, TMA, DEC, FEC, Compensações, etc);
  • Conduzir estudos quantitativos e analíticos;
  • Apresentar relatórios e conclusões com base nas modelagens aplicadas;
  • Analisar e reproduzir metodologias operacionais;
  • Estudar e manter-se atualizado quanto ao estado da arte em operação;
  • Criar alternativas “data driven” para subsídio gerencial da Light;
  • Estabelecer profundo relacionamento interno com as áreas operacionais, regulatórias, TI e financeiras da Light, para suporte operacional a tomada de decisão;
  • Produzir estudos de benchmarking;
  • Ser referência em conhecimento ágil para solução de problemas.


Requisitos necessários:


  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia, Estatística, Matemática ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Mestrado ou MBA em Economia ou Engenharia;
  • Desejável: Conhecimento de linguagem de programação aplicada a ciência de dados, como Phyton ou R.

Location: Brazil, Fully Remote

Setup: Consultancy / Freelance

Shift: EST Time Zone

Equipment: Must have own machine; equipment not provided



Position Overview

We are seeking a skilled Data Engineer to design, build, and optimize data migration pipelines that enable seamless transitions from legacy systems into our SaaS platform. You will work closely with both customers and internal teams to ensure data accuracy, reliability, and long-term scalability across our product ecosystem.



Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement ETL/ELT pipelines to migrate customer data from various legacy systems into the SDL SaaS platform
  • Transform datasets across multiple formats (e.g., SQL databases, APIs, flat files like CSV) ensuring data integrity and consistency
  • Build reusable components and tooling that support repeatable and scalable migration processes
  • Automate data extraction, transformation, and loading workflows to improve performance and efficiency
  • Partner with customers and cross-functional teams to deeply understand data requirements and resolve data-related challenges
  • Apply best practices in code quality, testing, CI/CD, and deployment to maintain a robust engineering ecosystem
  • Participate in peer code reviews and contribute to evolving engineering standards as we scale
  • Support ongoing process improvement by helping build foundational data engineering capabilities



Job Requirements

  • Proven experience in data engineering , ETL development , or data migration within a SaaS environment
  • Proficiency in Python for data transformation and automation scripting
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of SQL and experience working with relational databases
  • Ability to work with multiple data formats (e.g., CSV, structured/unstructured sources)
  • Strong analytical mindset with high attention to data accuracy and quality
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Knowledge of software development best practices, including version control and code reviews



Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with GIS technologies and spatial data formats such as shapefiles
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, Azure)
  • Experience building scalable data pipelines and automating complex workflows
  • Understanding of distributed systems or large-scale data processing architectures

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Onebridge, a Marlabs Company, is a global AI and Data Analytics Consulting Firm that empowers organizations worldwide to drive better outcomes through data and technology. You thrive in environments where experimentation meets engineering rigor, and you take pride in building systems that work reliably in the real world. You are the kind of person who enjoys staying ahead of industry trends—especially in LLMs and generative AI—and bringing that knowledge into practical, production-ready workflows. You’re excited by the opportunity to shape modern ML pipelines end‑to‑end, collaborate deeply with cross-functional teams, and continuously refine how AI drives value across an organization.

  • Build and optimize LLM-based solutions, including RAG approaches, embeddings, and semantic search capabilities.
  • Collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to translate business needs into strong ML/AI system designs.
  • Prototype and deploy ML and deep learning models for transformation, ranking, prediction, and other applied use cases.
  • Design native workflows on AWS using Lambda, Step Functions, SageMaker, Bedrock, AgentCore, and related services.
  • Implement observability and monitoring tools to ensure reliability, stability, and compliance of models in production.


Machine Learning Engineer | Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in Machine Learning, with a proven track record deploying end‑to‑end ML/AI systems in production.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS AI/ML services including SageMaker, Bedrock, Lambda, and Step Functions, along with MLOps best practices.
  • Strong knowledge of LLMs, RAG architectures, embeddings, and vector databases.
  • Proficiency in Python and ML/DL frameworks such as PyTorch and scikit‑learn, familiarity with transformer-based models.
  • Solid understanding of model deployment, containerization, and monitoring.
  • Experience with data engineering for ML workflows (feature pipelines, schema versioning, data quality controls).
  • Advanced English proficiency for communication with a global, distributed team.
